messages.msgid: You sense something emitting electricity here.
translations: 你感觉这里有东西在放电。

messages.msgid: You are wearing equipment that helps handle harsh climates.
A small battery to store electrical power in a static power grid.
translations: 一块能够储存电能来为电网供电的小型蓄电池。

messages.msgid: A unit of currency equivalent to 0.01 US dollars.
translations: 等效于0.01美元的货币单位。

messages.msgid: Time and the elements have reduced them to a mound of filthy ribbons.
translations: 时间和自然因素把它们变成了一堆肮脏的布带。

messages.msgid: A set of big pointy legs, like the ones found under a tripod.
translations: 一组大而尖的腿，就像在三足机器人用的那种。

messages.msgid: Leathery and heavily armored, your lamellar skin has toughened for the fiercest battles ahead.
translations: 鳞片覆盖了你像革一样坚韧的皮肤，并为将来最激烈的战斗变得又厚又硬。

messages.msgid: You flick the visor off, and push it off your face.
translations: 你关闭了护目镜，并把它从脸上抬起。

messages.msgid: You slip out of the top of the suit and tie the sleeves around your waist.
translations: 你脱下上衣，把袖子系在腰间。

messages.msgid: You untie the sleeves and put back on the top of the suit.
translations: 你解开袖子，重新穿好衣服。

messages.msgid: A gray work t-shirt with a small front pocket.
translations: 一件灰色的工作T恤，前面还有个小口袋。

messages.msgid: A thick mass of flesh superficially resembling a mammalian heart.  It's the size of your fist and covered in dimpled grooves.
translations: 一块厚厚的肉，表面看起来像哺乳动物的心脏。它有你的拳头那么大，上面覆盖着多处凹陷。

messages.msgid: A set of electronics to optimize emitter workcycle and increase overall energy efficiency.  Decreases power consumption.
translations: 一套用于优化发射器工作循环，增加整体能量效率的电路组合，可降低射击时的能量消耗。

messages.msgid: The laptop's batteries need more charge.
You stop lighting up the screen.
This phone is playing music, steadily raising your morale.  You can't hear anything else while you're listening.
translations: 这款手机正在播放音乐，稳步提升你的士气。你在听音乐的时候，听不到其他的声音。

messages.msgid: You've already activated the %s, try throwing it instead.
translations: 你已经激活了%s，赶紧丢出去。

messages.msgid: You've already pulled the %s's pin, try throwing it instead.
translations: 你拉下了%s的拉环，赶紧丢出去。

messages.msgid: You pull the pin on the grenade.
translations: 你拉开了手雷的保险销。

messages.msgid: You turn the heavy-duty flashlight off.
Your fur has grown out and thickened, providing great protection from attacks as well as considerable insulation.
translations: 你的皮肤组织发生了变异，体表的毛皮长得又浓又密，既可以很好的抵挡攻击，又相当保暖。

messages.msgid: A set of tentacles surrounds your mouth.  They allow you to eat twice as fast.  Slightly decreases wet penalties.
translations: 你嘴上长了很多触须。吃东西快了一倍。稍微减少湿身心情惩罚。

messages.msgid: Skin tabs and odd flaps of skin surround your mouth.  They don't affect your eating, but are unpleasant to look at.
translations: 你的嘴部环绕着褶皱和奇怪的皮瓣，它们并不影响你的进食，但看上去让人很不舒服。

messages.msgid: A table rig with a faucet for water tank access, fume hood, drawers and fixtures for storing tools, low power electric connectors and valves for fuel tank connections.
translations: 一套集成了水龙头（连接水箱）、通风橱、抽屉、工具固定架、低功率电连接器和燃料箱阀门的工作台设备。

messages.msgid: Strange proteins are ingesting radioactive particles and flushing themselves from the host.
translations: 奇怪的蛋白质在吸收放射性的粒子，并将自身排出宿主体内。

messages.msgid: Strange proteins are ingesting radioactive particles and containing all emmissions.
translations: 奇异蛋白质正在吞噬放射性粒子，从而抑制所有辐射外泄。
你服用了乳齿象诱变剂。

messages.msgid: You consumed a large amount of mastodon mutagen.
translations: 你服用了大量乳齿象诱变剂。

messages.msgid: You consumed a life-changing amount of mastodon mutagen.
translations: 你服用了能改变生命的乳齿象诱变剂。

messages.msgid: You consumed a large amount of mi-go mutagen.
translations: 你服用了大量米·戈诱变剂。

messages.msgid: You consumed a life-changing amount of mi-go mutagen.
translations: 你服用了能改变生命的米·戈诱变剂。

messages.msgid: A partial covering of foamcrete is slowing you down.
translations: 泡沫水泥覆盖在你身上，减慢了你的速度。

messages.msgid: The world is spinning around you, and you feel like you're going to die.
translations: 世界在你身边旋转，你感觉自己就要死了。
你的动作有如机器一般精准。

messages.msgid: As the synthetic blood decays and is purged throughout your bloodstream, you begin to feel minor symptoms of altitude sickness, making you sluggish and short of breath.
translations: 随着合成血液衰退并被排出血液系统时，你开始感觉到轻微的高原反应症状，使你行动迟缓，呼吸急促。

messages.msgid: Your breaths instinctively grows more shallow as the synthetic blood carries oxygen throughout your body, increasing your speed, stamina, and general endurance.
translations: 随着合成血将氧气输送到全身，你的呼吸本能地变得更浅，从而提高你的速度和耐力。

messages.msgid: Your breaths instinctively grow shallow as the synthetic blood carries oxygen throughout your body, increasing your speed, stamina, and general endurance.
translations: 随着合成血将氧气输送到全身，你的呼吸本能地变得更浅，你的速度和耐力增强了。

messages.msgid:
FE09-    A3 65 FF    ATT $#17A
FE0B-    4E          JMP $5010
FE0D-    A5 24       DEX $#05
translations:
FE09-    A3 65 FF    ATT $#17A
FE0B-    4E          JMP $5010
FE0D-    A5 24       DEX $#05

messages.msgid: You are flying with a rocket powered device.
translations: 你正借助火箭推进装置飞行。

messages.msgid: Even if its been critically damaged, this android continues to crawl towards its target.
translations: 即便身负重创，这具人形机器人依旧会挣扎着爬向目标。

messages.msgid: The main weaponry of this creature is no longer functional.
translations: 此生物的主要武装已失效。

messages.msgid: You are under the effects of powerful military combat stimulants
translations: 强力军用战斗兴奋剂生效中。

messages.msgid: The medical gel applied to your wounds is slowly healing them.
translations: 医用凝胶正缓缓修复你的伤口。

messages.msgid: The performance enhancing drugs slowly wear off and leave you in a state of existential grade hangover.
translations: 提高表现的药物效果开始渐渐消失，让你处于生存危机级别的宿醉状态。

messages.msgid: Post overdose quantities of multiple drugs in analyzed blood.
translations: 血液中存在多种致死剂量的药物。

messages.msgid: Dangerous levels of military grade nervous system medications.
translations: 危险品等级的军用神经系统药物。

messages.msgid: This creature is actively defending itself.
translations: 此生物正处于主动防御姿态。

messages.msgid: Your head is pounding and you feel unwell.
translations: 你的头很痛，感觉不舒服。

messages.msgid: Your head throbs and it's hard to see straight.
translations: 你的头在抽痛，很难看清楚。

messages.msgid: You can barely think through the pain in your head.
translations: 你几乎无法思考头脑中的痛苦。

messages.msgid: Your skull feels like it's going to explode.
translations: 你的头骨感觉要爆炸了。

messages.msgid: The agony is the only thing in the world that matters.
translations: 痛苦是世界上仅剩的事情了。

messages.msgid: Your powers reveal electrical creatures and robots to you.
translations: 你的灵能会向你展示带电生物和机器人。

messages.msgid: You can no longer sense the flow of current.
translations: 你再也感受不到电流的流动了。

messages.msgid: Your body is filled with electrical currents.
The tingling on your skin fades.
translations: 皮肤上的酥麻感消失了。

messages.msgid: The protective electrical currents are nearly gone.
translations: 保护性电流开始消失了。

messages.msgid: Your skin is losing its charge.
translations: 你的皮肤正在失去电荷。

messages.msgid: You are capable of hacking into computers with only the power of your mind.
translations: 你仅仅凭自己的思维就能入侵电脑。

messages.msgid: You can no longer manipulate the circuitry of nearby devices.
translations: 你无法再操纵附近的电子设备。

messages.msgid: You are generating a wireless aura of electrical power.
translations: 你身边环绕着无形的带电光环。

messages.msgid: You stop the flow of electricity to your devices.
translations: 你停止向随身个人设备供电。

messages.msgid: Your powers are affecting movement around you; dangerous objects are slowed and your own speed is increased.
translations: 你的灵能正在影响你周围的运动；危险物体的速度会减慢，你自己的速度也会增加。
附近的动量恢复了正常。

messages.msgid: You are looking out for other minds.
translations: 你开始探查其它的思维体。

messages.msgid: Your awareness of other minds fades away.
translations: 你对其他思维体的感知消失了。
你感知到此地存在智慧生物。

messages.msgid: You are preparing to influence the minds of others to make them more amenable to your point of view.
translations: 你正在准备对他人的心智施加影响，以使他们更易于接受你的观点。

messages.msgid: Your mind is warded against telepathic attack or detection.
translations: 你的思维对心灵攻击或侦测有所防护。

messages.msgid: Your thoughts are once again unguarded.
translations: 你的思维再次失去了防护。

messages.msgid: This item is an access card for ancient industrial locations.
translations: 这东西是古代工业场所的出入卡。

messages.msgid: This item is an access card for ancient police locations.
translations: 此为旧时代警用设施的门禁卡。

messages.msgid: This item is an access card for ancient Mercurial locations.
translations: 此为旧时代水银公司设施的门禁卡。

messages.msgid: This item is capable of projecting a Riemann protective shield.
translations: 此物品能够投射一道黎曼防护盾。

messages.msgid: Moving towards a survival horror full conversion mod set in a mostly abandoned extrasolar colony far from Earth hundreds of years from today.
translations: 一个未来开发目标是将游戏转变成类似生存恐怖片的完全转换模组，场景设置在距今数百年后的一个几乎被遗弃的远离地球的系外殖民地上。

messages.msgid: Back in the 21st century marksmanship was an art whose mastery meant arduous years of constant training and preparation.  There are computers for that now.
translations: 在遥远的21世纪，枪法还是一门艺术，它的掌握意味着多年的训练和准备。不过现在这种事情都交给电脑了。

messages.msgid: Your ability to manipulate psionic energy.

This is a cluster of multicolored membranous bubbles, each about the size of a grape, retrieved from inside an alien animal.  They float like tiny helium balloons - perhaps they are full of lighter-than-air gas.
translations: 一团五颜六色的薄膜状气泡，每一个都有葡萄大小，是从某种变异的外星生物体内屠宰而来的。它们像微小的氦气球一样在空中漂浮，可能内部充满了比空气还轻的气体。

messages.msgid: This wriggling nodule of resin and flesh appears to be secreting a pungent fluid.  You'd probably best feed it into the bioblaster.
translations: 这个正在蠕动的结节完全由树脂和血肉融合而成，似乎正在分泌出一种腐蚀性液体。你最好把它装填进生化热熔炮里。

messages.msgid: Single use software package that can be used to send encrypted communications.
translations: 可用于发送加密通信信号的一次性软件包。

messages.msgid: Your very own Project Excalibur.  Better get to defending America with it.
translations: 属于你自己的"亚瑟王神剑"计划。最好用它来保卫美国。

messages.msgid: Arrows made from nanoprinted materials where each layer of the arrow is designed for improved efficiency.  A layer that provides the least possible air resistance, followed by a layer of armor piercing, then followed by a frangible layer.  However, this makes each arrow single use.
translations: 用纳米打印材料制成的弓箭，每一层都经过设计来提高箭的效力。最外层提供最小的空气阻力，第二层提供穿甲性能，内层则用易碎材料制成。这使得每支弓箭只能发射一次。

messages.msgid: A gantry for supporting an exosuit upright during maintenance and repair.  Includes the specialized tools needed for complex repairs and will also charge the suit's power when active.
translations: 一台车载龙门吊，用于在维护和维修动力装甲时提供支撑。包括复杂维修所需的专用工具，激活时，还将为动力装甲充电。
U-344 放射性同位素热电发生器（已部署）

messages.msgid: A compact radioisotope thermoelectric generator, complying with UASTA 344 standards.  It provides a steady if limited supply of power.
translations: 一台紧凑型放射性同位素热电发生器，符合 UASTA 344 标准，可提供稳定但有限的电力。

messages.msgid: A light mounted on a tall expanded tri-pod.  Illuminates the area around itself when powered.
translations: 一盏安装在加高三脚架上的照明灯。通电后即可照亮周遭。

messages.msgid: A sleek, unfathomably-complicated machine covered in dozens of blinking lights, worn on the back by sturdy faux-leather straps.  An electrode dangles from the back, attaching to your forehead.  How it operates without annihilating spacetime isn't quite clear, but a localized portal allows things to be stored in an extradimensional space.
translations: 一个光滑的，深奥复杂的机器，上面有几十盏闪烁的灯，后面系着结实的人造皮带。一个电极从后面延伸到你的前额。你不知道它是怎么违背时空法则运行的，但你能用它将物品存储在一个超维度空间中。

messages.msgid: A lightweight armor vest made of pieces of titanium sewn together, with cloth padding for comfort.  Brittle against blunt force, but highly resistant to cuts and corrosion.
translations: 一种轻质装甲背心，由钛片缝合而成，带有舒适的布料衬垫。它对钝击伤害的防御性很低，但耐切割和腐蚀。

messages.msgid: When activated, creates a holographic decoy of its wearer.  Powered by an experimental n-space energy generator, it slowly recharges itself for free, probably by siphoning excess energy from some unknown hyperdimensional space.
translations: 激活后，将产生一个穿戴者的全息投影。它由一个实验型n维空间能量发生器供能，无消耗地缓慢为自身充能，很可能是吸收某个未知的高维空间中多余的能量来充能的。

messages.msgid: The vantablack cloak of sentinel-lx hangs around ones shoulders as a solid, unnatural shadow.  Made from woven graphene, it's lightweight and resistant, but cannot be repaired.
translations: 哨兵-lx型机器人的超黑色长披风，披在肩上如同一个实体而不自然的阴影。由编织石墨烯制成，轻便且坚固，但无法被修复。

messages.msgid: The original Imagos IX-2110, a general use wrist computer originally designed to support operations within hazardous environments.  Among the most successful pieces of technology ever created, millions of these were produced and sold to the explorers that first tamed the stars during the early Hyperspace Era.  The slow attrition of technological prowess since the discontinuity has left slightly slower than its modern counterparts.
translations: Imagos IX-2110 原本是一款通用腕式计算机，最初设计用于支持在危险环境中进行操作。它成为有史以来最成功的高科技产品之一，在超空间时代早期，数以百万计的相同型号被生产出来并销售给了首次征服恒星的探险家们。自大灾变后，科技能力的缓慢损耗使得它的运行稍微比现代竞品慢。

messages.msgid: The original Imagos IX-2110, a general use wrist computer originally designed to support operations within hazardous environments.  Among the most successful pieces of technology ever created, millions of these were produced and sold to the explorers that first tamed the stars during the early Hyperspace Era.  The slow attrition of technological prowess since the discontinuity means its only slightly less capable than its modern counterparts.
translations: Imagos IX-2110 原本是一款通用腕式计算机，最初设计用于支持在危险环境中进行操作。它成为有史以来最成功的高科技产品之一，在超空间时代早期，数以百万计的相同型号被生产出来并销售给了首次征服恒星的探险家们。自大灾变后，科技能力的缓慢损耗仅仅使得它的兼容性稍微比现代竞品差点。

messages.msgid: A rugged and radiation shielded wirst computer specifically designed to support salvage operations.  It can perform general computing tasks and might be used to interface with most ancient computer systems.
translations: 这是一款坚固耐用、具备辐射屏蔽功能的腕式电脑，专为支援回收作业而设计。它不仅能处理常规计算任务，还可用于接入大多数旧时代的计算机系统。

messages.msgid: Personal portable charging system consisting of an array of quantum solar panels neatly folded in the form of a large backpack.  It can be worn as one, and has an integrated cable to plug it into a cable charger system.  Cutting edge technology.
translations: 一套个人便携式充能系统，由一系列超能太阳能电池板组成，都被整齐地折叠并装入一个大背包。它可以一体式穿着在身上，并且集成了一条可插入电缆充电器的电缆。最新尖端科技。

messages.msgid: Unfolded array of portable quantum solar panels ready to push some power into an active cable charger system.
translations: 一套已经展开的便携式超能太阳能电池板阵列，准备好为电缆充电器提供能量。

messages.msgid: Modern oversized reinforced tactical combat boots.  Very durable.
translations:
一双具备良好的抓地力、增加脚踝稳定性以及可以保护足部的加大号现代战术靴，非常耐用。
"外型很酷，结实耐用，功能性强，这样的一双鞋在末世来说尤为重要。"

messages.msgid: A pair of oversized reinforced Kevlar tactical gloves.  Commonly used by police and military units.
translations: 一双加大号的凯夫拉强化战术手套，有防震，防滑等功能，于军方与警方之中广泛使用。

messages.msgid: A pair of reinforced Kevlar tactical gloves, specifically designed to accommodate three-fingered Killophants.  Thinner than regular oversized tactical gloves.
translations: 一双凯夫拉强化战术手套，有防震、防滑等功能，是为"杀人象"部队特制的三指款，相比常规的加大号战术手套更加纤细。

messages.msgid: An XL leather belt.  Useful for making your pair of pants fit if you need really big pants.
translations: 一条特大号的皮革腰带。能让裤子穿起来更合身。

messages.msgid: An XL black leather belt used by extremely large uplifted police officers.  It has several pouches and a holder for a baton.
translations: 一条特大号的黑色皮带，适合那些体型巨大的基因擢升警察们佩戴。它上面有几个袋子和一个警棍的插销。

messages.msgid: An all-encompassing massive black helmet that covers your entire face and neck, providing excellent protection from all sorts of damage.
translations: 一顶特大号的黑色极简头盔，覆盖面部和颈部，保护你免受各种伤害。

messages.msgid: An XL fabric ammo pouch that can be strapped to your leg; capable of holding two magazines close at hand.
translations: 一个绑在腿上的特大号布包，能够装下两个弹匣，保证弹药随手取用。

messages.msgid: A wetsuit designed for the Octopus Uplifts known as Cecaelia.  This is the explorer suit with no head or tentacle protection.
translations: 一种为基因擢升的章鱼人而设计的潜水衣，被称为塞卡莉亚。这是没有头部或触角保护的探险者套装。

messages.msgid: The combat version of the Cecaelia wetsuit; made of neoprene and Kevlar, it will provide some level of protection for deep dwellers.
translations: 塞卡莉亚潜水服的战斗版，由氯丁橡胶和凯夫拉制成，它将为深海居民提供一定程度的保护。

messages.msgid: A lightweight nanomesh vest designed to face down many of the perils of space travel.  These vests are mass produced and often stacked in starship lockers.
translations: 一件轻便的纳米网背心，设计用于面对太空旅行时的诸多威胁。这些背心是工厂批量生产的，经常堆放在星际飞船的储物柜里。

messages.msgid: This piece of armor hearkens back to renaissance designs.  It differs in that it is cast as a single piece in deep space installations where conditions can be controlled absolutely.  Not quite bulletproof, but it will stop most small arms fire.
translations: 这件胸甲的设计灵感源自文艺复兴时期，但其特别之处在于，它是在深空设施的绝对受控环境下一体铸造成型。此甲虽非坚不可摧，却也足以抵御多数轻武器的射击。

messages.msgid: This helmet is designed for the individual that is worried about catching heavy weapons fire to the face.  It is unwieldy and heavy, and lacks basic environmental protection features, but it just might stop even the largest of ballistic rounds.
translations: 这种头盔是为那些担心被重型武器直击面部的人设计的。它既累赘又笨重，也缺乏基本的环境防护功能，但它甚至能挡住最大口径的弹药。

messages.msgid: UICAS Tip of the Spear helmet
messages.plural: UICAS Tip of the Spear helmets

messages.msgid: An all-environment combat helmet issued to UICA espatiers.  Commonly known as 'the jar' due to its unusual clear polymer canopy that leaves its wearer's face visible.
translations: 分发给UICA星际战士的全环境作战头盔。常被称为"玻璃罐"，因为它有着与众不同的透明聚合物面罩，可以看清佩戴者的脸。

messages.msgid: A lightweight black helmet that provides excellent protection from all sorts of damage, unless it's airborne.  UICAS makes the point of designing all headgear whenever possible with clear faceplates, in order to provide a human touch to all interactions.
translations: 一顶轻便的黑色头盔，能够提供极好的伤害防护，除非是空气传播的病毒。UICAS 在设计头盔时极尽可能要求其具有清晰的前面罩，以便为所有互动提供人性化的感觉。

messages.msgid: A heavy battery cell, compatible with most industrial equipment but purposefully designed to power EVA suits  It's a bit too big to fit in most portable tools.

messages.msgid: This jar contains a human brain kept alive by mi-go technology.  It has metal veined tendrils that appear to allow it to connect to various devices.
translations: 这个罐子里装着一个人类的大脑，并由米·戈科技维持生存。它外部有许多金属的脉状卷须，似乎可以让它连接到各种设备。

messages.msgid: This heartlike organ has multiple valves and upon its proper removal from the bioweapons corpse each valve sealed itself.  It hums gently in your hands, as if waiting for an appropriate receptacle.
translations: 这个类似心脏的器官上有多个瓣膜，当它被正确地从生物武器的尸体上移除之后，所有阀门都会自动封闭起来。它在你的手中轻声地嗡嗡作响，仿佛在等待一个合适的容器。

messages.msgid: This lump of flesh has various lobes protruding from it that at intervals will emit toned sounds.  Perhaps it works via echolocation.  Like all mi-go bioparts the openings on this piece closed up after it was cut free and it seems to have gone into a form of hibernation with the pulses occurring slower and slower as it conserves energy.
translations: 这个肉块上有各种突出的叶片，每隔一段时间就会发出不同音调的声音。也许它可以通过回声定位。就像其他的米·戈生物身体部件一样，这块躯体的开口在它被从尸体上切除后就关闭了，它似乎进入了一种冬眠的形式，为了保存能量，脉动的速度越来越慢。

messages.msgid: This cross between a sea anemone and what you imagine a dragon's mouth would look like is the core body of the bioweapon.  You cannot imagine what you could make out of this but maybe someone somewhere does.
translations: 这个看上去像海葵和你所想象的巨龙龙嘴杂交而成的怪物是某种生物武器的核心部件。你无法想象你还能把它用来做什么，但也许在某个地方有某个人能够将它派上用场。

messages.msgid: A broken mi-go turret.  It's leaking fluids and smells you can't identify.  Could be butchered for parts.
translations: 一个损坏的米·戈炮塔。它正在泄漏出你无法辨认的气味和液体。可以拆解得到部件。

messages.msgid: You ripped this from a mi-go abomination.  You think you should wear gloves to reload it.
translations: 这玩意是你从一台米·戈怪物上撕下来了的。你觉得自己在给它重新装填弹药时得戴上手套。

messages.msgid: The only copy of Housefly in existence - a long book about three individuals drawn together by fate in the early 1800s to save their English town of Victoria from a mysterious threat.  You never got to publish it, but reading it lets you forget the horrors of the Cataclysm, if only for a moment.
translations: 《家蝇》现存的唯一版本——这是一本关于三个人的长篇小说，讲述了19世纪初，为了拯救他们的英国小镇维多利亚免遭神秘威胁，命运将他们联结在了一起。你永远没有机会出版它了，但阅读它可以让你忘记大灾变的恐怖，即使只有片刻。

messages.msgid: Unofficial History of Salus IV Vol. 1
translations: 萨勒斯四号星 非官方历史（卷一）
messages.plural: copies of Unofficial History of Salus IV Vol. 1

messages.msgid: Welcome to Frozen Hell, an unofficial history of Salus IV by Bette Lapin.  Salus IV was founded in the early days of the Hyperspace Era as a joint venture between Mercurial Genomics and a Soviet Design Bureau.  At its height several hundred years ago Salus IV had just over 110 million citizens (including both uplifts and humans). However, that population had begun to decline even before the Discontinuity as people migrated to planets that, while more hostile to life during the earliest colonization phases than Salus IV, were much simpler to terraform into a place more enjoyable by human and uplift citizens.
translations: 欢迎来到冰冻地狱，由贝特·拉宾编写的萨勒斯四号星的非官方历史。萨勒斯四号星是在超空间时代早期，由水星基因公司和苏维埃设计局联合建立的。在几百年前的鼎盛时期，萨勒斯四号星上有约一亿一千万公民（包括擢升种族和人类），但即便是在大灾变出现之前，星球人口就已经开始减少，因为人们迁移到了各个比萨勒斯四号星相对而言，处于在早期殖民阶段，生命更难生存的行星上，只因为对其他星球进行气候改造使其适应于人类及擢升动物生存要容易得多。

messages.msgid: Unofficial History of Salus IV Vol. 2
translations: 萨勒斯四号星 非官方历史（卷二）
messages.plural: copies of Unofficial History of Salus IV Vol. 2

messages.msgid: Even during the Discontinuity Salus IV's population continued to drop as there were easier places to live even in the Salus system - from honeycombed asteroid habitats to domed cities with gorgeous views.  Mercurial Genomics was an early member of the nascent post-Discontinuity government efforts.  As a result of this membership, they have successfully reclaimed Salus IV in the court system set up by ESCA.  The Whately family, which runs Mercurial Genomics, began leasing development and exploitation permits and allows the establishment of minor UICA outposts within Salus IV.  There is an official citizen count of less than twenty thousand sentient beings, albeit mostly in orbit.  It is believed, however, that there are at least that many non-citizen sentients spread amongst squatter, smuggler, pirate, and feral uplift communities.
translations: 即使在大灾变时期，萨勒斯四号星的人口依旧继续流失，因为在萨勒斯星系中有更容易居住的地方，从蜂巢形小行星居住站，到有壮丽美景的圆顶城市。水星基因公司也是努力构建后隔绝时代新兴政府的早期成员之一。由于这一成员资格，他们也成功地在ESCA建立的法院系统中收回了萨勒斯四号星系的主权。沃特利家族，作为水星基因公司的实际控制者，开始出售开发和利用许可证，并允许在萨勒斯四号星上建立小型UICA前哨站。据官方统计，萨勒斯四号星目前仅存不到5万智能生命体，大部分居住在萨勒斯四号星轨道上。但据信，至少有许多非公民的智能生命散布在星球地表居住，包含非法定居者，走私者，海盗和野生基因擢升动物种群。

messages.msgid: Unofficial History of Salus IV Vol. 3
translations: 萨勒斯四号星 非官方历史（卷三）
messages.plural: copies of Unofficial History of Salus IV Vol. 3

messages.msgid: The Salus system is what is called a hinge system for the new FTL travels.  This system contains a number of easy exit points to star systems that have no other easy way to travel to each other than through a series of systems with low to zero civilization in them.  Salus has several interstellar refueling points.  These stations are often blind to each other as the planets and other objects rotate around the sun.  Mercurial seems to have no interest in managing or protecting the traffic that flows through the Salus system or in neighboring systems beyond the bare minimum effort required by UICA.  As a result of this neglect; victims of pirate attacks, engine failure and other critical issues regularly limp to whatever safety they can find in the Salus system.  Unfortunately for many of them they will crash land on Salus IV where there are few regular shuttles between its scattered ports and the outside universe.  As the locals are fond of saying 'Getting to Salus IV is hard, getting off may be impossible'.
translations: 萨勒斯星系被称为新一代超光速旅行枢纽星系。此星系中包含许多能很容易到达其他恒星系的出口，而这些星系之间除了经过一系列文明程度低到零的星球外，没有其他简单方式彼此相联。萨勒斯星系内有几个星际加油点。随着行星和其他天体围绕恒星旋转，这些空间站常常彼此无法通讯。水星公司除了满足UICA所要求的最小工作量外，似乎对管理或保护途经萨勒斯星系或邻近星系的交通不感兴趣。由于这种疏忽；海盗袭击、引擎故障和其他严重问题的受害者经常只能一瘸一拐地躲进他们能在萨勒斯星系内找到仅存的安全地带。不幸的是，他们中的许多人都坠毁在萨勒斯四号星上，那里只有散布在星球上的零星几个太空港有定期穿梭机与外部宇宙联系。正如当地人喜欢说的"想去萨勒斯四号星很难，而要离开它更是不可能"。

messages.plural: copies of Nuclear Physics Made Easy

messages.msgid: A book detailing the workings of state of the art atomic technology, and the physics behind it.
translations: 一本教科书，详细介绍了最尖端的核能技术的运作流程，以及背后的核物理学理论知识。

messages.msgid: A binder containing detailed production logs from an industrial mealworm farm.  You could use its recordings to start your own farming operations.
translations: 这本活页夹中包含了详尽的工业化粉虫养殖场生产记录，凭借它你可以开始自己的粉虫养殖。

messages.msgid: Bearing the logo of Northrop, those are assembly plans, design specs, and technical drawings for the chicken walker.  Most of this is useless to you, but you could use the assembly plans to re-assemble the robot from salvaged parts.
translations: 印有诺斯洛普标志的双足机器人组合施工图、设计规范以及技术图纸。其中大部分没什么用了，但是可以根据组合施工图回收零部件重新组装机器人。

messages.msgid: Bearing the logo of Matrioshka Fabritechnics, those are assembly plans, design specs, and technical drawings for the diamond press.  Most of this is useless to you, but you could use the assembly plans to re-assemble the robot from salvaged parts.
translations: 印有玛特廖什卡工业科技标志的钻石压机施工图、设计规范以及技术图纸。其中大部分没什么用了，但是可以根据组合施工图回收零部件重新组装机器人。

messages.msgid: Bearing the logo of Matrioshka Fabritechnics, those are assembly plans, design specs, and technical drawings for the nano forge.  Most of this is useless to you, but you could use the assembly plans to re-assemble the robot from salvaged parts.
translations: 印有玛特廖什卡工业科技标志的纳米熔炉施工图、设计规范以及技术图纸。其中大部分没什么用了，但是可以根据组合施工图回收零部件重新组装机器人。

messages.msgid: Bearing the logo of Northrop, those are assembly plans, design specs, and technical drawings for the tank drone.  Most of this is useless to you, but you could use the assembly plans to re-assemble the robot from salvaged parts.
translations: 印有诺斯洛普标志的坦克无人机组合施工图、设计规范以及技术图纸。其中大部分没什么用了，但是可以根据组合施工图回收零部件重新组装机器人。

messages.msgid: Bearing the logo of Honda, those are assembly plans, design specs, and technical drawings for the tripod.  Most of this is useless to you, but you could use the assembly plans to re-assemble the robot from salvaged parts.
translations: 印有本田标志的三足机器人组合施工图、设计规范以及技术图纸。其中大部分没什么用了，但是可以根据组合施工图回收零部件重新组装机器人。

messages.msgid: Assembly plans, design specs, and technical drawings for the eyebot.  Most of this is useless to you, but you could use the assembly plans to re-assemble the robot from salvaged parts.
translations: 眼球无人机的组合施工图、设计规范以及技术图纸。其中大部分没什么用了，但是可以根据组合施工图回收零部件重新组装机器人。

messages.msgid: Assembly plans, design specs, and technical drawings for the police bot.  Most of this is useless to you, but you could use the assembly plans to re-assemble the robot from salvaged parts.
translations: 警用机器人的组合施工图、设计规范以及技术图纸。其中大部分没什么用了，但是可以根据组合施工图回收零部件重新组装机器人。

messages.msgid: Assembly plans, design specs, and technical drawings for the riot control bot.  Most of this is useless to you, but you could use the assembly plans to re-assemble the robot from salvaged parts.
translations: 防暴机器人的组合施工图、设计规范以及技术图纸。其中大部分没什么用了，但是可以根据组合施工图回收零部件重新组装机器人。

messages.msgid: A small folio indicating how to best utilize the equipment of your landfall survival kit during an emergency.  Its first page urges you to remain calm, and to consult your escape pod's control console for further instructions.
translations: 一本说明如何在紧急情况下最有效地使用着陆生存工具箱的小册子。手册的第一页提醒你保持冷静，并查阅逃生舱的控制台以获得进一步的指示。

messages.msgid: Cyrus Whateley's Notes on Repurposing mi-go victims
A folio of notes written by a madman.  They seem to suggest ways to re-animate the dead and create various affronts to the natural order.
translations: 一个疯子写的一叠纸条。里面似乎描述了一种让死者复生的方法，以及各种对自然秩序创造生命方式的各种侮辱冒犯。

messages.plural: copies of Dr. Moreau and You

messages.msgid: In what many considered a stunning example of poor taste and others considered overt speciesism this text on the creation of Uplifted Animals references a story about sapient animals killing their creator.  Otherwise a dry text about genetic modification.
translations: 这本讲述基因擢升生物的书籍引用了一个智慧生物杀死其制造者的科幻故事，辅以骇人听闻的低级趣味和公然的物种歧视观点。除此之外，其中还记录了一些干巴巴的关于基因编辑的内容。

messages.msgid: A pocket-sized book filled to the margins with cramped handwriting and notes on the biology of Mi-Go and other musings.  It's hard to understand and quite gruesome in some places and written in a shorthand or cipher in others.
translations: 一本字里行间填满了潦草仓促笔迹的口袋书，其中记录着关于米·戈的生物学笔记和作者的其他冥想。它有一些地方相当隐晦而难以理解，其他部分则以某种速记符号或密码编写而成。

messages.plural: copies of useful recipes for resistance

messages.msgid: Recipes for Resistance is a collection of tales, strategies and recipes for working against corporate rule.  Very simple language is used in the recipes but it drags out the explanations.
translations: 有效的抵抗教程是一本关于反抗公司统治的故事、策略和教程的合集。它使用的语言很简单易懂，但是行文比较拖沓。

messages.msgid: Working in Boreal Conditions and Beyond
messages.plural: copies of Working in Boreal Conditions and Beyond

messages.msgid: A corporate manual for conditions of inhospitable cold.  It includes instructions for building devices and substances that will aid in survival in extreme weather or even the lack thereof.
translations: 一本关于应对非宜居严寒环境的公司手册。里面包括如何在极端天气中（或者连天气都没有的地方）制造设备和物资以辅助生存的方法。
巨型企业罕见弹药目录
messages.plural: copies of Unusual Ammunitions of the Corporations

messages.msgid: A lab book dedicated to reverse engineering various ammunitions found throughout the solar system.  Written in a format to allow barely trained technicians to *safely* replicate these rounds.
translations: 一本专门对太阳系各处发现的各种罕见弹药进行逆向工程的实验室文档。文档所使用的语法格式可以让几乎没有受过任何训练的技工*安全地*复制这些弹药的制造流程。
萨勒斯四号星 地衣应用研究
messages.plural: copies of Applications of Salus IV Lichen

messages.msgid: A sheaf of notes detailing some species of lichen.  Most of the information is useless to you except for the fact that the majority of Salus IV lifeform's metabolism rely on a macronutrient that acts like a neurotoxin for humans.  One useful note is a detailed procedure to neutralize said neurotoxin.
translations: 一沓详细记录了某种地衣特性的笔记。其中大多数信息对你来说都是无用的，除了提到萨勒斯四号星上生命体的大部分新陈代谢依赖于某种对人类具有神经毒素效果的常量营养元素。其中一项有用的记录详细描述了如何中和上述神经毒素的方法。

messages.plural: copies of TsKBEM Exoskeleton user manuals

messages.msgid:
A somewhat hefty manual in Russian with accompanying English text which goes in-depth into the proper usage and maintenance of TsKBEM brand Exoskeletons.

While it mainly pertains to the old TsKBEM exoskeletons, the knowledge within could still help out with modular exoskeletons in general.
translations:
这是一本有点厚重的俄语手册，附带英文文本，深入介绍了如何正确使用和维护TsKBEM出品的动力装甲。
虽然它主要是关于旧型号的TsKBEM动力装甲的，但其中的知识仍然可以帮助解决模块化动力装甲的常见问题。

messages.msgid: This annual publication covers the various ways in which people use technology to improve their bodies.  There are a few in-depth and thoroughly illustrated articles on prosthetics, though they tend to use too much jargon.
translations: 这本年鉴里有许多关于"人类运用科技自我强化的方法"的文章，也有几篇深度讲解义肢改造系统的论文，不过术语有点多。

messages.msgid: A large casing from a spent 25mm cartridge.
translations: 25mm 榴弹发射后留下的大号弹壳。

messages.msgid: An empty plastic hull from a 5x50mm flechette round.
A small metallic sphere with a recessed bottom up top.  When activated it will allow you to swap positions with an existing hologram.
translations: 一个小型金属球体，顶部有个凹进的底座。激活后，它将让你能够与已经存在的全息投影互换位置。

messages.msgid: A small metallic sphere with a recessed bottom up top.  When activated it will allow you to select a hologram, which will explode in a blinding flash, stunning anything nearby.
translations: 一个小型金属球体，顶部有个凹进的底座。激活后，选择一个全息投影，它将爆炸成炫目的光芒，伤害并晕眩附近的生物。

messages.msgid: A small metallic sphere with a recessed bottom up top.  When activated it will a holographic decoy in a location of your choosing.
translations: 一个小型金属球体，顶部有个凹进的底座。激活后，它将在所选位置处召唤出一个全息投影。

messages.msgid: A small metallic sphere with a recessed bottom up top.  When activated it will create several holographic decoys around you.
translations: 一个小型金属球体，顶部有个凹进的底座。激活后，它将在你四周召唤出几个全息投影。

messages.msgid: A complex antennae assembly worn around the upper torso that allows its user to teleport towards previously configured teleport pads.  Although relatively functional, it's much inferior to the translocation systems of old, and a successful teleport requires standing perfectly still for several minutes.

An arcane device from the late Hyperspace Era, vaguely resembling a wrist computer made from malleable glass.  It can be activated to quickly deploy a translocator buoy or to teleport to previously activated buoys.
translations: 一个从超空间时代晚期流传下来的神秘装置，外形大概类似于一台由可延展玻璃制成的腕式计算机。它可以被激活以快速部署传送位标或传送到先前已被编码激活的位标。

messages.msgid: Installed on your back is a set of retractable solar panels.  When in direct sunlight, they will automatically deploy and slowly recharge your power level.
translations: 你的背上安装了一排可伸缩的太阳能面板。当你站在阳光下时，它们会自动伸出并缓慢为你充能生化能量。

messages.msgid: A miniaturized fusion reactor.  It has modest output, but will run continuously for over two hundred years thanks to its internal nuclear fuel reservoir.
translations: 一个微型化的核聚变反应堆。 它的输出功率不高，但由于内部有核燃料贮存池，它可以持续运行两百多年。

messages.msgid: A small, folding tube that attaches to your right arm.  Once implanted, it can serve as a portable, integrated tool for firing 40mm grenades and canisters.
translations: 你的右臂里植入了一个微型可折叠枪管。植入后，它可以视为一个便携式的集成发射器，发射40毫米榴弹和霰弹。

messages.msgid: A carbon nanotube wire covertly installed in your right arm.  When activated, it extends to its full length and can be used to strike enemies both at close and long range.
translations: 一条碳纳米管线被隐蔽地植入你的右臂内，激活后会伸展至全长，可用于近距离和远距离的敌人进行打击。

messages.msgid: A Mercurial Genomics brand biofactory that replaces the user's blood with a synthetic substitute.  Primarily designed to boost combat performance, its common among the corporation's own security forces.  The biofactory can't be removed once integrated with a host.

An implanted miniaturized computer isolated from the rest of your systems by military-grade firewalls.  An accompanying jack allows you to interface with external computer systems with minimal risk.  Skill in computers is important, and a failed use may damage your circuits.
translations: 一个植入式微型计算机，通过军事级防火墙与你其余的系统隔离开来。配套的接口让你能够以最低风险与外部计算机系统进行连接。计算机技能很重要，使用不当可能会损坏你的电路。

messages.msgid: A high voltage battery port compatible with the power cartridges normally used in military weaponry.  Intended to supplement internally installed power generation and storage.
translations: 提供一种与军事武器中通常使用的能量电池兼容的高压电池接口。旨在为内部安装的能源供应和储能装置提供补充。

messages.msgid: A radical nanite treatment that allows its host's circulatory system to function as a secondary nervous system, greatly increasing their mental acuity and allowing them to survive trauma that would otherwise be fatal.  A cybernetic enhancement of this category is a rare find and could be easily traded for significant favors and resources.
translations: 一种激进的纳米机器人疗法，可使宿主的循环系统充当第二套神经系统，大大提高他们的精神敏锐度，使他们能够在本来会致命的创伤中存活下来。 这种类型的生化增强技术非常罕见，可以轻易地换取大量的好处和资源。

messages.msgid: A microcomputer installed into the left hemisphere of your brain to increase the speed that it processes language.  When installed, it provides a passive boost to reading speed.
translations: 一台微型计算机植入到你大脑左半球，以提高它处理文本信息的速度。植入后，它可以被动地提高阅读速度。

messages.msgid: Pre-Discontinuity bionic module that was implanted into elite drop troops who could jump from their insertion vehicle during the radar disruption of reentry.  While active, the field will prevent damage to your body from severe impacts, at the cost of impaired movement.
translations: 大灾变前的生化插件，被植入精英星际伞兵，在空投时的雷达干扰段，精英星际伞兵可以从空投舱上跳下。开启时，重力场将防止严重撞击对身体造成损害，但会影响运动能力。

messages.msgid: A battered and used Compact Bionics Module that upgrades the user's power capacity by 50 units.  Having at least one of these is a prerequisite to using powered bionics.  The user will also need a power supply, found in various CBMs.
translations: 一套曾被植入过的，残缺的小型生化电池插件，可以为受体增加50点生化能量储备上限。受体至少需要一个储能模块才能使用耗能型生化插件，同时还需要至少一种供能型生化插件为其充能

messages.msgid: A set of tiny bionic nerve stimulators that install into the reward center of your brain.  When run with bionic power, it periodically releases a hit of dopamine and other reward chemicals, inducing a state of euphoria and suppressing fear.
translations: 一套微型生化神经刺激器，植入了你大脑的激励中心。当开启时，它会消耗生化能量周期性地释放多巴胺和其他激励化学物质，让你处于极乐状态并抑制恐惧。

messages.msgid: Cybernetic stimulators installed across your nervous system boost your reflexes whenever you are hit in melee, granting you an extra action.  This bionic must be active to function.
translations: 你的神经系统被植入了生化刺激装置，提高你的反应能力。每当你在近战中被敌人击中，就能获得额外的行动点。这个生化插件仅在激活时生效。

messages.msgid: An improved ulnar sheath equipped with thermal inductors allows for the super heating of all types of implanted bladed weaponry.  While this bionic is active, any deployed bionic blades will deal additional fire damage to targets.
translations: 改进后的尺骨鞘配备了热感应器，可以加热所有类型的刀刃类植入武器。 此生化插件激活时，任何激活的生化刀刃都会对目标造成额外的火焰伤害。

messages.msgid: Paired capacitor banks maintain implanted bladed weaponry under constant electrical charge.  While this bionic is active, any deployed bionic blades will deal additional electric damage with a chance of the damage arcing to other nearby targets.
translations: 电容对阵列对生化插件刀刃施加恒定的电势差。此生化插件激活时，任何激活的生化刀刃都会造成额外电击伤害，并且有机会对其他邻近目标发射电弧。

messages.msgid: An implanted AI executes the optimal followup for each of your melee strikes, allowing you to chain them with unnatural speed and grace.  This bionic must be active to function.
translations: 你体内被植入了一个人工智能系统，能够在你的每次近战攻击后执行最优化的后续行动，让你以非自然的速度和优雅的姿势衔接每次攻击。这个生化插件仅在激活时生效。

messages.msgid: A brain implant that grants instinctual knowledge about the operation of flying machines.
translations: 一个脑内植入体，能够赋予你本能一般的操作飞行器械的知识。

messages.msgid: A bomb installed where your spine meets your brain stem.  It's on a timer from installation and you don't have the codes to reset the timer.
translations: 一个安装在脊柱和脑干交汇处的炸弹。它在安装时就被设置了一个定时器，而你没有能够重置定时器的代码。

messages.msgid: Chemical Enhancement Rig and computer CBM
messages.plural: Chemical Enhancement Rig and computer CBMs

messages.msgid: An implanted AI module and medication dispenser calculates the optimal chemical mix to keep you on your toes and ready for combat.  This bionic must be active to function and while it functions your body is at a heightened performance but if it turns off it will take you several days to get back to normal.  There are a significant number of baseline bonuses granted by this setup but people around will notice your junkie behavior.  This bionic must be active to function.
translations: 植入的人工智能模块和药物分施装置计算出最佳的化学混合物，让你保持时刻警觉和战斗准备。这个仿生体必须处于开启状态才能发挥作用。当它发挥作用时，你的身体性能提升，但如果它关闭，你将需要几天时间才能恢复正常。这种设备有大量的基础能力奖励，但周围的人将注意到你的吸毒行为。这种仿生体必须处于活跃状态才能发挥作用。

messages.msgid: Should never be found outside of the chemical enhancement rig, but probably can be uninstalled, there is no point to doing that.
translations: 应该永远不会在化学增强装置之外发现，但可能可以卸载，这样做没有意义。

messages.msgid: A single shot 10mm gun which implants into the forehead.  It has the shortest time from thought to shot of all bionic guns which makes it popular among street punks for whom every millisecond counts, but this poorly conceived bionic removes a distressing amount of grey matter to make room for it and gives you a concussion every time you fire it.
translations: 这是一把单发射击的10毫米口径的枪，通过手术植入前额。由于它是所有生化武器中，从产生射击念头到实际发射所需时间最短的，因而深受那些分秒必争的街头帮派成员的青睐。但是这种设计欠佳的生化改造为了安装枪械，会移除相当多的脑灰质，并且每次射击都会导致使用者脑震荡。

messages.msgid: An experimental teleportation system carefully weaved into bone marrow and coiled alongside the skeletal system.  It allows its user to safely and readily teleport towards a previously activated telepad.
translations: 一套实验性的传送系统，被精心植入你的骨髓，缠绕在骨骼系统周围。它能让你安全便捷地传送到一处先前激活的远程传送平台上。

messages.msgid: A system designed to prevent instantaneous frostbite in workers exposed to things like hard vacuum and liquid nitrogen.
translations: 该系统被设计来预防暴露于高真空和液氮等环境中的工人瞬间冻伤。
霍金公司 I 型护盾(CBM)

messages.msgid: Imagine a computer inside your body playing pong against the universe.  The paddles are made of energy fields and how it causes this to happen are trade secrets.  -From the owners manual of HawkingCorps GravyField Mark I.  Activating the field will reduce incoming bashing and cut damage by 5 points.
translations: 想象一下，你体内有台计算机正在与整个宇宙打乒乓球。球拍是由能量力场组成的，它是如何让这一切发生则是商业机密——摘自霍金集团力场I型CBM的用户手册。开启时，力场将使得所受钝击和斩击伤害降低5点。
霍金公司 V 型护盾(CBM)

messages.msgid:
Powerful and covert, the Mark V Shield is a military-grade shielding system developed for use within UICA's special service branches.  Although much more effective than anything that could be conceived with current technology, it remains a pale imitation of the Hyperspace Age systems it was reverse-engineered from.  A.

Activating the shield will create an energy barrier capable of withstanding a modest amount of melee and ranged damage.
translations:
V型护盾是一款强大而隐秘的军用级护盾系统，专为UICA的特勤部门所开发。它虽远比当前技术所能企及的任何造物都更为有效，但与它所逆向仿制的超空间时代系统相比，终究只是个拙劣的仿品。

激活护盾将生成一道能量屏障，能够抵御一定程度的近战与远程伤害。

messages.msgid: A powerful shielding system salvaged from a pre-Discontinuity robotic warframe, crudely adapted for compatibility with biological hosts.  Powerful enough to completely stop most rifle cartridges.  Activating the field will reduce incoming ballistic and piercing damage by 40 points.
translations: 这套强大的护盾系统是从一台大灾变前的机器人作战机甲上拆解下来的，经过粗糙改装后才得以兼容生物宿主。其威力足以完全格挡多数步枪子弹。激活力场可将受到的弹道与穿刺伤害降低40点。

messages.msgid: This is a metal box containing survival supplies, often found within ships and their escape pods.  Its cyan highlights indicate that it's a simpler Type II kit, and that it would only be helpful in a planet whose atmosphere and gravity are within two deviations from Earth's.
translations: 这是一个装满了求生用品的金属盒子，通常能在飞船和它们的逃生舱中找到。它的青色标记表明它是更简单的II型，只能在大气和重力与地球偏差在两个标准差范围内的行星使用。

messages.msgid: A standard orbital cargo transfer container.  Its faceted corners are adorned with the livery of company you don't recognize.
translations: 标准轨道货物转运集装箱。它多面体的角上装饰着你所不认识的公司的涂装标志。

messages.msgid: Marketing has adorned the package of this individual ration with white and red livery, a deliberate callback to the space corporations of old.  Despite best efforts, the food within is no more natural than usual, but is at least palatable.
translations: 这种个人口粮的红白色涂装是向古代太空企业致敬的营销手段。 尽管已经尽了最大努力，里面的食物还是不比平常的食物更天然，但是至少适宜食用。

messages.msgid: A plastic and aluminum foil bag for long term food storage.
translations: 用于长期储存食物的塑料铝箔袋。

messages.msgid: The corpse of a long-dead colonist.  Near perfectly preserved by the merciless cold.
translations: 一具早已死去的拓荒者的尸体。被无情的寒冷几乎完美地保存了下来。

messages.msgid: The irreparably broken remains of a Sentinel-lx.  Could be gutted for valuable parts.
translations: 一个损坏的哨兵-LX型机器人。可以拆解得到部件。

messages.msgid: This bloodhound won't be chasing anyone anymore.  Could be gutted for parts.
translations: 一个损坏的猎犬无人机，再也没法追人了。可以拆解得到部件。
报废的农事领主无人机

messages.msgid: A broken Seneschal, now limp and unmoving.  Could be gutted for parts or crafted into a salvaged robot.
translations: 一个损坏的总管型机器人。现在安静的散在地上构不成威胁了。可以拆解得到部件或者改装再利用。

messages.msgid: A broken Likvidator, now limp and unmoving.  Could be gutted for parts or crafted into a salvaged robot.
translations: 一个损坏的清算者型机器人。现在安静的散在地上构不成威胁了。可以拆解得到部件或者改装再利用。

messages.msgid: A broken Famulus, now silent and mangled.  If it wasn't for the obvious rivets and welding, it would look completely human.  Could be stripped down for parts.
translations: 一个损坏的仆从型机器人。现在安静的散在地上构不成威胁了。可以拆解得到部件。

messages.msgid: A broken Udarnik, now wrecked and immobile.  Could be stripped down for parts.
translations: 一个损坏的劳模型机器人。现在安静的散在地上构不成威胁了。可以拆解得到部件。

messages.msgid: A broken Brandspojt, now cold and inert.  Could be stripped down for parts.
translations: 一个损坏的火流星型机器人。现在安静的散在地上构不成威胁了。可以拆解得到部件。

messages.msgid: A broken rat snatcher, now harmless and inert.  Could be stripped down or re-crafted.
translations: 一个损坏的捕鼠无人机。可以拆解得到部件或者改装再利用。

messages.msgid: A broken grabber robot, now limp and nonthreatening.  Could be stripped down or re-crafted.
translations: 一个损坏的擒拿无人机。可以拆解得到部件或者改装再利用。

messages.msgid: A broken pest hunter, now harmless and inert.  Could be gutted for parts or re-crafted.
translations: 一个损坏的灭害无人机。可以拆解得到部件或者改装再利用。

messages.msgid: A broken military humaniform, shattered and inert.  While it looks nowhere near human, you still feel uneasy - as if it is studying you with its eyes.  Could be stripped for parts.
translations: 一个损坏的执像者型无人机。现在安静的散在地上构不成威胁了。可以拆解得到部件。

messages.msgid: A broken Suppressor, shattered and inert.  Could be stripped for parts.
translations: 一个损坏的压制者型无人机。现在安静的散在地上构不成威胁了。可以拆解得到部件。

messages.msgid: A broken floating heater, now cold and motionless.  Could be stripped down or re-crafted.
translations: 一个损坏的浮空加热器。可以拆解得到部件或者改装再利用。
无武装高级无人机（损坏）

messages.msgid: A broken advanced robot.  Its internal weapons have been removed.  Could be gutted for parts or crafted into a salvaged robot.
translations: 一个损坏的高级无人机。内置武器已经被拆卸掉。可以拆解得到部件或者改装再利用。

messages.msgid: A broken advanced robot.  This one is armed with an integrated laser-emitter.  Could be stripped for parts.
translations: 一个损坏的高级无人机，内置了一把激光武器。现在安静的散在地上构不成威胁了。可以拆解得到部件。

messages.msgid: The irreparably broken remains of an Irradiant weapons platform.  Its mounted plasma cannon self-destructed when the robot was rendered inoperable, but its remains could still be disassembled for some valuable parts.
translations: 一台无法修复的辉光型武器平台的残骸。当机器人失控时，它所安装的等离子炮启动了自毁程序，但它的残骸仍然可以拆解成一些有价值的部件。

messages.msgid: The broken shell of an Isohypsa drone coordinator.  Most of its sensors and AI units are charred beyond any repair.
translations: 一台无法修复的等高图型机器人的残骸。它的大部分传感器和AI装置都烧焦了，无法修复。

messages.msgid: A broken Kabura-ya drone.  Could be disassembled for a meager amount of parts.
translations: 一台响箭型无人机的残骸。可以可以拆解获得少量部件。

messages.msgid: A broken advanced robot.  This one is armed with an integrated EMP projector.  Could be stripped for parts.
translations: 一个损坏的高级无人机，内置了一把EMP发射器。现在安静的散在地上构不成威胁了。可以拆解得到部件。
无武装军用无人机（损坏）

messages.msgid: A broken defense robot.  Its internal weapons have been removed.  Could be gutted for parts or crafted into a salvaged robot.
translations: 一个损坏的防御无人机。内置武器已经被拆卸掉。可以拆解得到部件或者改装再利用。
无武装防御无人机（损坏）
外科手术型机器人（损坏）

messages.msgid: A broken surgical robot, now crumpled and inert.  Could be stripped down for parts.
translations: 一个损坏的外科手术型机器人。现在安静的散在地上构不成威胁了。可以拆解得到部件。

messages.msgid: A broken eyebot.  Much less threatening now that it won't be calling for backup.  Could be gutted for parts.
translations: 一台损坏的眼球无人机。因为再也不能呼叫支援所以不再构成威胁。可以拆解得到部件。

messages.msgid: A spent shock-mine, inert and harmless.  Cannot be recharged, but some of its components could be recycled.
translations: 一枚耗尽的电击地雷，现已失效且无害。它无法再充电，但其部分组件或可回收利用。

messages.msgid: A broken zenit security drone.  Could be disassembled for robotic components and heavy armor.
translations: 一台报废的泽尼特安保无人机。可拆解成机器人组件与重型装甲。

messages.msgid: A broken police bot.  Much less threatening now that it's quiet and still.  Could be gutted for parts.
translations: 一台损坏的警用机器人。看起来没什么威胁安静的躺在地上。可以拆解得到部件。

messages.msgid: A broken riot control bot.  Much less threatening now that it's out of gas.  Could be gutted for parts.
translations: 一台损坏的防暴机器人。现在它催泪瓦斯已经耗尽构不成威胁了。可以拆解得到部件。

messages.msgid: UICA's normally digital currency, rendered physical for use in the frontier.  The card can be programmed with any amount of United Solar Denominations and is commonly used to anonymously transfer funds.
translations: UICA常见的数字货币，在边远星区被制成实体卡以供使用。这种卡可以被设定为任意数量的太阳系联合币(USD)，并且常被用于匿名转账。

messages.msgid: UICA's normally digital currency, rendered physical for use in the frontier.  Worth exactly 1 United Solar Denomination.
translations: UICA的官方货币原为数字形式，这是为了方便在边境流通而铸造的实体代币。面值1联合太阳币。

messages.msgid: UICA's normally digital currency, rendered physical for use in the frontier.  Worth exactly 10 United Solar Denominations.
translations: UICA的官方货币原为数字形式，这是为了方便在边境流通而铸造的实体代币。面值10联合太阳币。

messages.msgid: UICA's normally digital currency, rendered physical for use in the frontier.  Worth exactly 50 United Solar Denominations.
translations: UICA的官方货币原为数字形式，这是为了方便在边境流通而铸造的实体代币。面值50联合太阳币。

messages.msgid: UICA's normally digital currency, rendered physical for use in the frontier.  Worth exactly a 100 United Solar Denominations.
translations: UICA的官方货币原为数字形式，这是为了方便在边境流通而铸造的实体代币。面值100联合太阳币。

messages.msgid: UICA's normally digital currency, rendered physical for use in the frontier.  Worth exactly a 1000 United Solar Denominations.
translations: UICA的官方货币原为数字形式，这是为了方便在边境流通而铸造的实体代币。面值1000联合太阳币。

messages.msgid: UICA's normally digital currency, rendered physical for use in the frontier.  Worth exactly 10000 United Solar Denominations.
translations: UICA的官方货币原为数字形式，这是为了方便在边境流通而铸造的实体代币。面值10000联合太阳币。
你可以黑掉附近的设备。

messages.msgid: A thick layer of something that smells worse than walrus fat.  But it keeps you warm.
translations: 一层比海象油还难闻的乳霜。不过这能帮助你保暖。

messages.msgid: The last word in cold snap protection designed to give short term protection in the event of a suit breach in vacuum.
translations: 急速防寒的终极定论，被设计来在真空防护服破裂事件中提供短期保护。

messages.msgid: This stitched together abomination in human form lies still and waiting for you to give it the spark of life.  In all likelihood you are the monster.
translations: 这个缝合而成可憎人形怪物静止不动，等待着你赋予它生命的火花。十之八九，你才是那个怪物。

messages.msgid: A single-use genetic treatment that can grant or remove the contained trait.  Can be used in gene editing machinery, which Mercurial normally offers free of charge in a bid to popularize augmentation in the general public.
translations: 一个一次性的基因疗程，可赋予或去除特定的基因性状。 可用于基因编辑机器，水星基因公司通常免费提供这种机器，以向大众普及基因改造技术。

messages.msgid: A reusable genetic treatment that can grant or remove the contained trait as many times as needed.
translations: 一个可重复使用的基因疗程，可根据需要任意次数地赋予或去除其中所包含的基因性状。
响箭型无人机自爆装置

messages.msgid: A tiny plastic explosive meant to be installed in a Kabura-ya drone.  Explodes 3 turns after activation.
translations: 一个装在响箭型无人机上的微型塑胶炸药。激活后3回合爆炸。
响箭型无人机自爆装置（激活）

messages.msgid: A tiny plastic explosive meant to be installed within a Kabura-ya drone.  It is on the verge of exploding.
translations: 一个装在响箭型无人机上的微型塑胶炸药。它快要爆炸了。

messages.msgid: A powerful explosive with a highly focused blast radius, often used for mining or demolition work.  It's configured to work alongside a radio detonator, and will explode immediately after activation.
translations: 一种爆炸半径高度集中的强力炸药，通常用于采矿或拆除作业。它被配置成需要与无线电雷管一起工作，并在激活后立即爆炸。

messages.msgid: A powerful explosive with a highly focused blast radius, often used for mining or demolition work.  It's currently active.
translations: 一种爆炸半径高度集中的强力炸药，通常用于采矿或拆除作业。它已经被激活。

messages.msgid: A high explosive grenade that deals most of its damage through a powerful shockwave.  Reduced shrapnel makes it much safer to use in open spaces.
translations: 一种高爆手雷，主要通过强大的爆炸冲击造成伤害。较少的破片使其在空旷地带使用时更加安全。

messages.msgid: A high explosive grenade that deals most of its damage through a powerful shockwave.  It's currently active.
translations: 一种以强力冲击波为主要杀伤方式的高爆手雷。现已激活。

messages.msgid: This is an electronic weapon that will emit a short-ranged electric field.  When activated, you'll have five turns before it starts doing so; throwing it before that would be a good idea.
translations: 电击手雷，使用此物品以拔掉插销。之后五回合它就会把周围变成一片电场，记得扔远点。

messages.msgid: This electroshock grenade is currently creating a dangerous electric field.
translations: 这个电击手雷正在释放致命的电场。

messages.msgid: This is a military-grade cryo hand grenade.  Once it explodes it spreads exotic highly-radioactive shrapnel.  Use this item to pull the pin and light the fuse.  You will then have five seconds before it explodes; throwing it would be a good idea.
translations: 一个军用冰冻手雷，一旦引爆，就会散播出特制的强吸热弹片。使用此物品以拔掉插销，之后你有五秒的时间去扔掉它。

messages.msgid: This is an active grenade, and will explode any second now.  Once it explodes it spreads exotic highly-thermodynamic shrapnel.  Better throw it!
translations: 一个拔了插销的冰冻手雷，随时都会爆炸，一旦引爆，它就会散播出特制的强吸热弹片。最好扔出去！赶紧扔敌人脸上！

messages.msgid: A neurotoxic device that deploys thick swathes of toxic foam upon detonation.  Exposure proves fatal within seconds.  Use against human targets is considered in breach of the Ganymede Accords.
translations: 一种在引爆时会释放大片剧毒泡沫的神经毒素装置。一旦接触，数秒内便会毙命。根据《木卫三协定》，严禁将其用于人类目标。
已激活的神经毒素手雷

messages.msgid: A neurotoxic device that deploys thick swathes of toxic foam upon detonation.  It's currently active.
translations: 一种在引爆时会释放大片剧毒泡沫的神经毒素装置。现已激活。

messages.msgid: A favorite tool of mutineers everywhere, this is a standard issue oxygen candle deliberately tampered to explode upon activation.  Its fuse is dangerously short, so you won't want to waste any time.
translations: 全世界反叛者们最喜欢的家伙，这个标准型氧烛被刻意改造成一激活就爆炸。它的引信短得惊险无比，所以你不想浪费任何时间。

messages.msgid: You pull the pin on the bomb.
translations: 你拔掉了炸弹上的插梢。

messages.msgid: This bomb's fuse is lit, and it will explode any second now.  Throw it immediately!
translations: 炸弹的引信已点燃，随时都会爆炸。赶紧扔掉！

messages.msgid: A pressurized plasma reactor that is on the verge of a catastrophic explosion.
translations: 一座处于灾难性爆炸边缘的加压等离子反应堆。

messages.msgid: This is your personal ID card.  The reverse side describes the protocol for using it; this grants you access to the barracks locker room.
translations: 一张你的身份卡。背面描述了使用规范；这张能让你进入军营更衣室。

messages.msgid: This is an ID card you found.  The reverse side describes the protocol for using it; this grants you access to the barracks locker room.
translations: 你捡到的一张身份卡。背面描述了使用规范；这张能让你进入军营更衣室。

messages.msgid: This is an ID card you found.  The reverse side describes the protocol for using it; this grants you access to the workshop's exosuit storage bay.
translations: 你捡到的一张身份卡。背面描述了使用规范；这张能让你进入舱外服库。

messages.msgid: A slim card that is used to initialize a STEED, which will then imprint the rider's biometric data and follow them unerringly.
translations: 一张用于初始化 STEED 的超薄卡片，STEED 会在卡片上印上骑行者的生物识别数据，然后准确无误地跟踪他们。

messages.msgid: A master keycard for all TSKBEM prefab industrial infrastructure built before the year 2152.  Invaluable to anyone seeking to salvage the industrial ruins of Orion.
translations: 用于 2152 年前建造的所有 TSKBEM 预制工业基础设施的主密钥卡。 对任何想要抢救猎户座工业废墟的人来说都是无价之宝。

messages.msgid: Issued only to the highest echelons of Mercurial corporate security, these cards provide unfettered access to all enforcer prefab facilites built before the year 2152.  A lucrative find for any salvor on Salus IV.
translations: 此卡仅配发给水星公司安保部门的最高层，可无限制地出入所有于2152年前建造的执法者预制设施。对于萨勒斯四号星上的任何拾荒者而言，这都堪称至宝。

messages.msgid: A master keycard for nearly all Mercurial corporate facilities and infrastructure built before the year 2152.  Invaluable on Salus IV, this card will grant you entry to all but the most secure Mercurial facilities.
translations: 一张适用于几乎所有2152年前建造的水星公司设施与基建的万能门禁卡。此卡在萨勒斯四号星上价值连城，可凭其进入除最高安保等级外的所有水星公司设施。

messages.msgid: This is a horrifying monstrosity.  Using this item is cannibalism in all but taste and involves turning it on and placing it on the ground, where it will attach itself.  If reprogrammed and rewired successfully the turret will identify you as a friendly, and attack all enemies with its revolving laser cannons.
translations: 一台未激活的可怖的脑熔炮塔。使用该物品以将它放置在地上启动，不过这样做除了不入口外和吃人也没什么区别。若成功编程放置，激光防御塔会将你识别为友方，并采用内置转轮激光炮攻击附近的所有敌人。

messages.msgid: The brain blaster swivels towards you.  Hi new friend!
translations: 脑熔炮转向了你。嗨，新朋友！

messages.msgid: The brain blaster swivels towards you.  You feel a buzzing in the air.
translations: 脑熔炮转向了你。你感到周围的空气正嗡嗡作响。

messages.msgid: This is an inactive Beagle Mini-Tank UGV.  Using this item involves placing it on the ground, loading the unit with the factory-loaded 5.56 rounds and 40mm cartridge grenades in your inventory (if you wish to divide your ammunition, set aside whatever ammunition you do NOT want to give the robot) and turning it on.  If reprogrammed and rewired successfully the tank drone will then identify you as a friendly, roam around or follow you, and attack all enemies with a built-in firearm and grenade launcher.
translations: 一台未激活的"猎兔犬"型无人坦克车。使用该物品以将它放置在地上启动，并装填你物品栏内的原装 5.56mm 弹药和 40mm 榴弹（如果你只想装填部分弹药，请先把不需装填的弹药移出物品栏）。若成功编程放置，无人车会将你识别为友方，自主行动或跟随你，并采用内置步枪和榴弹发射器攻击附近的所有敌人。

messages.msgid: The tank drone rolls out and begins acquiring targets.
translations: 坦克无人机展开并开始寻找目标。

messages.msgid: The tank drone swivels its turret and aims directly at you.  Don your brown pants!
translations: 坦克无人机旋转炮塔，直接瞄准了你。穿上裤子快跑！

messages.msgid: This is an inactive chicken walker.  Using this item involves placing it on the ground, loading the unit with the factory-loaded 5.56 rounds and 40mm cartridge grenades in your inventory (if you wish to divide your ammunition, set aside whatever ammunition you do NOT want to give the robot) and turning it on.  If reprogrammed and rewired successfully the tank drone will then identify you as a friendly, roam around or follow you, and attack all enemies with a built-in firearm and grenade launcher.
translations: 一台未激活的双足机器人。使用该物品以将它放置在地上启动，并装填你物品栏内的原装 5.56mm 弹药和 40mm 榴弹（如果你只想装填部分弹药，请先把不需装填的弹药移出物品栏）。若成功编程放置，机器人会将你识别为友方，自主行动或跟随你，并采用内置步枪和榴弹发射器攻击附近的所有敌人。

messages.msgid: The chicken bot rolls out and begins acquiring targets.
translations: 双足机器人展开并开始寻找目标。

messages.msgid: The chicken bot swivels its turret and aims directly at you.  Don your brown pants!
translations: 双足机器人旋转炮塔，直接瞄准了你。穿上裤子快跑！

messages.msgid: This is an inactive Honda Regnal.  Using this item involves placing it on the ground, wondering how it fuels its flamethrower and turning it on.  If reprogrammed and rewired successfully the tribot will then identify you as an ally, roam around or follow you, and impale hostiles with its spiked cable weapons.
translations: 一台未激活的三足机器人。使用该物品以将它放置在地上启动。它的火焰喷射器的燃料来源成谜。若成功编程放置，三足机器人会将你识别为友方，自主行动或跟随你，并用其带刺的电缆武器刺穿敌人。

messages.msgid: The tribot rises to its feet and scans the area for contaminants.
translations: 三足机器人开始移动并扫描该地区的污染物。

messages.msgid: The tribot glowers down at you and ignites its flamethrower.  Turns out you hate the smell of napalm.
translations: 三足机器人锁定了你，点燃的喷火器直接瞄准了你。看来你并不喜欢凝固汽油的味道。

messages.msgid: A broken tribot.  Now that its legs lie broken and immobile, the world seems a little less threatening.  Could be gutted for parts.
translations: 一个损坏的三足机器人。现在它的腿断了一地，世界又多了一份和平。可以拆解得到部件。
损坏的蝎型清扫机器人

messages.msgid: A broken Scavbot Skorpion.  Now that its legs lie broken and immobile, the world seems a little less threatening.  Could be gutted for parts.
translations: 一只坏掉的 Scavbot Skorpion。 现在它的腿断了，动弹不得，世界似乎也没那么可怕了。 可以把它拆成零件。

messages.msgid: A broken tank drone.  Still looks intimidating despite being permanently inoperative, possibly due to the sheer size and mass.  Could be gutted for parts.
translations: 一个损坏的坦克无人机。可能因为巨大的体积和质量的缘故，就算已经永久无法继续运作依旧看起来可怕无比。可以拆解得到部件。

messages.msgid: A broken chicken walker.  Still looks intimidating despite being permanently inoperative, possibly due to the sheer size and mass.  Could be gutted for parts.
translations: 一个损坏的双足机器人。可能因为巨大的体积和质量的缘故，就算已经永久无法继续运作依旧看起来可怕无比。可以拆解得到部件。

messages.msgid: Crouched and dead still, this armored luxurious robot resembles an ancient knight immersed in deep prayer.  If reprogrammed and rewired successfully the robot will identify you as a friendly, and will protect you from nearby foes.
translations: 这是一台未激活的哨兵-LX 型机器人。这台豪华的装甲机器人一动不动地蹲伏在地，如同一个沉浸在祈祷中的古代骑士。使用该物品以将它放置在地面上并重新激活其机械体。若成功编程放置，哨兵-LX 型机器人会将你识别为友方，守护你免受附近敌人的伤害。

messages.msgid: An inactive Kabura-ya hunter drone, folded for ease of storage.  If deployed, it will seek and fly to the closest enemy before detonating.  Unlike most robots, its activation depends on a successful throw, and not on your computer skill.
translations: 一台未激活的响箭型无人机，已被折叠起来便于储存。当成功部署时，它会飞向敌对目标并引爆自己。与其他无人机不同，激活这种无人机只需要一次成功的投掷，而无需电脑技能。

messages.msgid: The Kabura-ya emits a short IFF chirp as you throw it.
translations: 在你丢出响箭型无人机时，它发出滴滴的友军识别声。

messages.msgid: The Kabura-ya emits an warning whine after your botched throw!
translations: 在你丢出响箭型无人机时，它发出尖锐的警告声。

messages.msgid: This is an inactive bloodhound drone.  If successfully deployed, it will fly towards enemy targets and highlight them with a powerful spotlight.
translations: 一台未激活的猎犬无人机。当成功部署时，它会飞向敌对目标并用它的高功率探照灯照亮目标。

messages.msgid: The bloodhound drone flies from your hand and surveys the area!
translations: 这台猎犬无人机从你手上飞起，在附近区域自动寻找目标中！

messages.msgid: You misprogram the bloodhound drone; it's hostile!
translations: 你没设好猎犬无人机的程序，它现在变成敌对的了！

messages.msgid: This is an inactive laser turret.  Using this item involves turning it on and placing it on the ground, where it will attach itself.  If reprogrammed and rewired successfully the turret will identify you as a friendly, and attack all enemies with its replaceable laser cannons.  It requires ammunition tubes to fire.
translations: 一台未激活的激光塔。使用该物品以将它放置在地上启动。若成功编程放置，激光防御塔会将你识别为友方，并采用内置激光炮攻击附近的所有敌人。炮塔发射需要消耗大量能量，发射后需要手动更换枪管。

messages.msgid: A salvaged utility robot converted into an ambulatory bee hive that periodically removes and delivers segments of fresh honey comb.  It protects the insect colony with a mechanical crossbow mounted to its chassis.  Activate this item, with wooden bolts in your inventory, to load and deploy the robot.
translations: 一台改装的通用机器人，被用作移动蜂箱，每隔一段时间会产出一些新鲜的蜂巢。它使用一把安装在外壳上的机械弩保护体内的蜂群。当你物品栏中有木制弩矢时，你可以使用该物品以装填并部署该机器人。

messages.msgid: A less-than-lethal mine that emits a powerful electrical shock when triggered.  Activate this item to deploy the mine, which will have a lifetime of 10 hours after activation.
translations: 一种非致命性地雷，触发时会释放强烈的电击。激活此物即可部署地雷，启动后可持续运作10小时。

messages.msgid: This is an inactive manhack.  Manhacks are fist-sized robots that fly through the air.  They are covered with whirring blades and attack by throwing themselves against their target.  Use this item to reprogram and activate the manhack.  Electronics and computer skill determines if the targeting matrix is reprogrammed successfully.
translations: 一台未激活的飞锯无人机，一种拳头大小的飞行机器人。这台无人机的表面布满了嗡嗡作响的刀刃，通过撞击目标来攻击敌人。使用它以将其激活。电子学和计算机学等级决定了你将其重新编程的成功几率。

messages.msgid: An inactive floating lantern, a fist-sized robot that flies through the air and illuminates its surroundings with bright LEDs.  The lantern is non aggressive and has no means of attack.  Activate this item to deploy the salvaged robot.
translations: 一台未激活的浮灯无人机，一种拳头大小的飞行机器人。它使用明亮的 LED 照亮周围。浮灯无人机没有武器，也不会攻击敌人。使用该物品以部署该无人机。

messages.msgid: The floating lantern flies from your hand and lights up the area!
translations: 这台浮灯无人机从你手上飞起，照亮了这个区域！
你没设好这台浮灯无人机的程序。

messages.msgid: An unpowered military robot fitted with an integrated 7.62 firearm and electric prod.  Activate this item, with ammo in your inventory, to load and deploy the robot.
translations: 一台未激活的军用无人机，装有一把内置 7.62mm 口径步枪及一把电击枪。当你的物品栏中有弹药时，你可以使用该物品以装填并部署该机器人。

messages.msgid: A small hexapod drone designed to hold small pests, folded into a small cube for easy storage.  It's capable of hunting all sorts of small mammals with remarkable efficiency, but shouldn't be expected to handle anything much bigger than a rat.
translations: 一台小型六足无人机，设计用于害虫控制，被折叠成一个小立方体以便储存。它能够以惊人的效率捕杀各种小型害兽，但别指望它能对付任何体型比老鼠大的东西。

messages.msgid: A salvaged skitterbot repurposed to grab onto and immobilize enemies.  Activate this item to deploy the robot.
translations: 一台改装的掠行无人机，用于擒拿敌人使其无法移动。使用该物品以部署该机器人。

messages.msgid: A salvaged skitterbot refitted with an 8mm integrated firearm.  Activate this item, with ammo in your inventory, to load and deploy the robot.
translations: 一台改装的掠行无人机，装有一把内置 8mm 无壳弹手枪。当你物品栏中有弹药时，你可以使用该物品以装填并部署该机器人。

messages.msgid: A salvaged eyebot repurposed into a floating space heater.  It emits a constant jet of warm air to heat an enclosed space.  It is non-aggressive and has no weapons systems.  Activate this item to deploy the robot.
translations: 一台改装的眼球无人机，被用作悬浮的加热器。这台机器人用一束持续的暖流对封闭空间进行加热。它没有武器，也不会攻击敌人。使用该物品以部署该机器人。

messages.msgid: This is an inactive laser turret.  Using this item involves turning it on and placing it on the ground, where it will attach itself.  If reprogrammed and rewired successfully the turret will identify you as a friendly, and attack all enemies with its revolving laser cannons.  It requires sunlight in order to fire.
translations: 一台未激活的激光塔。使用该物品以将它放置在地上启动。若成功编程放置，激光防御塔会将你识别为友方，并采用内置转轮激光炮攻击附近的所有敌人。它需要日光照射以获取开火所需的能源。

messages.msgid: An inactive eyebot.  Using this item involves turning it on and launching the UAV.  If reprogrammed and rewired successfully, the eyebot will then keep watch for intruders.
translations: 一台未激活的眼球无人机。使用该物品以将它启动并释放。若成功编程放置，眼球机器人会持续寻找入侵者。

messages.msgid: The eyebot hums and takes to the sky.
translations: 眼球无人机嗡嗡作响，飞向天空。

messages.msgid: The eyebot beeps disapprovingly and focuses its camera on your face.  Say cheese!
translations:
眼球无人机发出不认同的哔哔声，并将相机对准了你的脸。
"茄子！"

messages.msgid: An inactive police robot.  Using this item involves placing it on the ground and turning it on.  If reprogrammed and rewired successfully, the police bot will then identify you as law enforcement, roam around or follow you, and attempt to detain lawbreakers.
translations: 一台未激活的警用机器人。使用该物品以将它放置在地上启动。若成功编程放置，警用机器人会将你识别为执法人员，自主行动或跟随你，并尝试拘捕违法者。

messages.msgid: The police bot rolls into action, ready to pursue criminals.
translations: 警用机器人开始行动，准备追捕罪犯。

messages.msgid: A siren howls and lights flash as the police bot prepares to arrest you!
translations: 警笛响亮，警灯闪烁……警用机器人正准备逮捕你！

messages.msgid: An inactive riot control bot.  Using this item involves placing it on the ground and turning it on.  If reprogrammed and rewired successfully, the robot will bring order and peace to the horde.
translations: 一台未激活的防暴机器人。使用该物品以将它放置在地上启动。若成功编程放置，防暴机器人将会给尸潮带去秩序与和平。

messages.msgid: The riot control bot rolls into action.
The riot control bot gasses you and approaches with a pair of handcuffs!
translations: 防暴机器人喷射着催眠瓦斯，带着一副手铐向你靠近。
你感觉到这里有东西在动。

messages.msgid: Reduces incoming bash and cut damage by 25.
translations: 减少25点受到的钝击和斩击伤害。

messages.msgid: Reduces incoming pierce and bullet damage by 40.
translations: 减少25点受到的刺击和子弹伤害。

messages.msgid: Your active jumpsuit helps maintain your body temperature.
translations: 你的动力连体服正在帮助你稳定体温。

messages.msgid: You are wearing equipment that gives 20kg carry weight.
Your gun aims itself, reducing your dispersion by 90%.
translations: 你的枪能够自行瞄准，使散布降低90%。

messages.msgid: Your gear relays targeting data to your weapons, reducing dispersion by 10%.
translations: 你的装备会将目标数据实时传输至武器，令弹着点散布降低10%。

messages.msgid: PrepNet had been heavily involved in avoiding taxes by using untraceable internet currencies.  These however are physical coins with random numbers sequences embossed on them and RFID chips inside.
translations: PrepNet一直在大量使用无法追踪的互联网数字货币来避税。这些实体硬币上面印有随机数序列，表明了其内部嵌入的RFID芯片所对应的数字货币。

messages.msgid: Truly putting the 'distress' in 'distress beacon,' this one has a huge hole in the front.  It will not be alerting anyone today.  Perhaps you could disassemble it for scrap.
translations: 一个确实"遇难"了的"遇难信标"。这个信标前面有一个巨大的洞。现在它不会向任何人发出警报。也许你可以把它拆解来得到废料。

messages.msgid: A piece of light titanium, usable for crafting or repairs.
translations: 一小块的钛，可以用来制造或修理物品。

messages.msgid: A small pellet of silvery metal, still warm to the touch.
translations: 一些银白色的金属小球，摸上去还有点温热。

messages.msgid: A broken chunk of clearcrete.  Basically a clear rock.
translations: 一块破碎的清凝土块。如同一块透明的石头。

messages.msgid: A small pellet of fissile material.  Handle carefully.
translations: 一些核裂变燃料小球，处理时要多加小心。

messages.msgid: A yellow drum meant for the storage of hazardous substances.
translations: 一个黄色大桶，上面印有辐射警告标识，用于储存放射性废料。

messages.msgid: The Rivtech Churninator 4000, the only churn to be banned by 13 religious sects.  The legs are currently folded up for travel.  Unlike a standard churn that requires cream separated from raw milk this churn requires only raw milk, salt and a healthy respect for glowing objects.
translations: Rivtech搅拌终结者4000型，世上唯一一种被13种不同宗教教派禁用的搅拌机。支架已经被折叠起来便于携带。不同于普通搅拌器需要事先将奶油从生奶中分离，这台搅拌机只需要你手头有生牛奶，食用盐以及对闪闪发光的辐射机器的适当尊重。

messages.msgid: A strong, durable metal.  Highly valued for its weight to strength ratio and an excellent upgrade to aluminum for those properties - albeit a lot more expensive due to rarity.  More commonly used in jewelry and medical implants.
translations: 一小块坚固耐磨的金属。由于其重量强度比很高，相比同类铝制品在各项性能上都有极大提升，但也因其稀缺性，价格要贵得多。它更常用于珠宝和医用植入设备上。

messages.msgid: An internal implant to correct a musculoskeletal problem such as a bad hip or back.  It is made of titanium due to its biocompatibility.
translations: 一款植入人体体内的医用植入物，用于矫正如臀部或背部损伤等肌肉骨骼伤病。由于需要有良好的生物相容性，它由钛制成。

messages.msgid: A dental implant made of pure titanium, used to replace teeth due to its biocompatibility and durability.
translations: 一款由纯钛制成的牙科植入物，由于其良好的生物相容性和耐用性而用于替代破损的牙齿。

messages.msgid: A thick, masculine watch made out of titanium.  It is durable, light-weight and water-resistant, an excellent watch to have in a hostile environment.
translations: 一块厚实的男性手表，由钛制成。它十分耐用，轻便且防水，是一款极佳的适合在恶劣环境下佩戴的手表。

messages.msgid: A thick, masculine ring made out of titanium.  Made in a variety of styles and finishes, they're valued for their durability.
translations: 一只厚实的男性戒指，由钛制成。外观融合了多种不同风格的样式和饰面，由于其经久耐用而价值不菲。

messages.msgid: A very heavy sphere of radiation shielding completely obscures the inner workings of this hyperspace-age device.  Any experienced salvor knows that opening it would completely ruin it.
translations: 一个极为沉重的辐射屏蔽球体，将这件超空间时代设备的内部结构完全遮蔽。任何老练的拾荒者都清楚，贸然打开只会彻底将其损毁。

messages.msgid: This transparent slate of computation glass was once an incredibly versatile hypercloud access point.  It continues to display "No Connection" in ancient English script.
translations: 这块透明的计算玻璃板曾是一个功能极其强大的超云接入点，如今屏幕上只以古老的英文字体持续显示着“No Connection”。

messages.msgid: This transparent lune of computation glass was once an incredibly versatile hypercloud access point.  It continues to display "No Connection" in ancient English script.  Although completely useless these sometimes gain popularity as a fashion accessory.
translations: 这块新月形的透明计算玻璃曾是一个功能极其强大的超云接入点，如今屏幕上只以古老的英文字体持续显示着“No Connection”。虽已毫无用处，但它时常会作为一种时尚饰品而受到追捧。

messages.msgid: A creased card with images and a personal message.
translations: 一张贴着照片并写满了个人信息的带有折痕的卡片。

messages.msgid: A super-concentrated mutagen strongly resembling a lava lamp.
translations: 一种经过处理的诱变剂引物，看上去就像熔岩灯一样。

messages.msgid: An extremely rare mutagen cocktail, it smells of sulfur and glows orange.
translations: 一种极度罕见的混合诱变剂，闻上去就像是硫磺，散发着橙色的光。

messages.msgid: A processed mutagenic primer not for those frightened of this thing they have become.
translations: 一种经过处理的诱变剂引物，不适合那些恐惧此类事物的人。

messages.msgid: An extremely rare mutagen cocktail, it seeks to cure what's deep inside.
translations: 一种极度罕见的混合诱变剂，它试图治愈其内在深处的某物。

messages.msgid: An encrypted Wraitheon industrial production chip.  The executive logo embossed on its lower right imply its contents are extremely valuable.
translations: 一个加密的"鬼神"工业生产芯片。其右下方压印的执行标志意味着其内容极为宝贵。

messages.msgid: A standard pattern detonator fabricated for military and industrial use.  This is an advanced model capable of controlling explosive drones alongside simpler devices.
translations: 军用和工业用的标准型号雷管。这是一种更先进的型号，能够控制爆炸无人机和更简单的装置。

messages.msgid: What's left when you remove all moving parts and electronics.  It's the skeleton and armor of the tripod.
translations: 移除所有可动部件和电子设备时剩下的，是三足机器人的骨架和装甲。

messages.msgid: What's left when you remove all moving parts and electronics.  It's the skeleton and armor of the Pathfinder.
translations: 移除所有可动部件和电子设备时剩下的，是"开拓者"型无人机的骨架和装甲。

messages.msgid: What's left when you remove all moving parts and electronics.  It's the skeleton and armor of the Regulator tank.
translations: 移除所有可动部件和电子设备时剩下的，是"监管者"型无人坦克的骨架和装甲。

messages.msgid: What's left when you remove all moving parts and electronics.  It's the skeleton and armor of the Seneschal.
translations: 移除所有可动部件和电子设备时剩下的，是"总管"型机器人的骨架和装甲。

messages.msgid: What's left when you remove all moving parts and electronics.  It's the skeleton and armor of the Likvidator.
translations: 移除所有可动部件和电子设备时剩下的，是"清算者"型机器人的骨架和装甲。

messages.msgid: What's left when you remove all moving parts and electronics.  Looking at it fills you with uneasiness as the Famulus stares at you with empty eyes.
translations: 移除所有可动部件和电子设备时剩下的，是"仆从"型机器人的骨架和装甲。

messages.msgid: What's left when you remove all moving parts and electronics.  It's the skeleton and armor of the Udarnik.
translations: 移除所有可动部件和电子设备时剩下的，是"劳模"型机器人的骨架和装甲。

messages.msgid: What's left when you remove all moving parts and electronics.  It's the skeleton and armor of the Brandspojt.
translations: 移除所有可动部件和电子设备时剩下的，是"火流星"型机器人的骨架和装甲。
外科手术型机器人底盘

messages.msgid: What's left when you remove all moving parts and electronics.  It's the skeleton and armor of the surgical droid.
translations: 移除所有可动部件和电子设备时剩下的，是"外科手术"型机器人的骨架和装甲。

messages.msgid: What's left when you remove all moving parts and electronics.  It's the skeleton and armor of the military robot.
translations: 移除所有可动部件和电子设备时剩下的，是军用无人机的骨架和装甲。

messages.msgid: What's left when you remove all moving parts and electronics.  You still feel deep down that its hollow eyes are studying you.
translations: 移除所有可动部件和电子设备时剩下的，是军用人型机器人的骨架和装甲。

messages.msgid: A set of reverse-jointed legs, like the ones found under a chicken walker.
translations: 一组反关节的腿，就像在双足机器人用的那种。

messages.msgid: Roots of a pineapple plant, for growing your own.
translations: 菠萝的根茎，你可以用它来种出你自己的菠萝。
一些橙子种苗。肯定是转基因产品。
一些柠檬种苗。肯定是转基因产品。

messages.msgid: Proof that man went too far before the Cataclysm.
translations: 证明人类在大灾变之前走得太远了。

messages.msgid: Never charge your phone again with the Rivtech atomic smartphone.  Rated for 10 million years of use, this cutting-edge gadget had been on public markets for less than a week when the Cataclysm hit, and their eye-watering price made them a rarity.  It includes an alarm clock, a high-resolution camera, and a bright flashlight.
translations: 使用Rivtech原子智能手机后，你再也不需要给手机充电了。这台尖端设备的使用期超过1000万年，在大灾变来临前，它上市还不到一个星期，贵到令人想哭的价格使其成为稀缺品。它包括一个闹钟、一个高分辨率照相机和一个明亮的手电筒。

messages.msgid: A compact imaging tool, capable of scanning and visualizing objects hiding behind walls, maintenance panels and all other sort of visual barriers.  While normally used to diagnostic potential faults within the internal systems of spaceships, the ability to peer between obstacles grant it obvious surveillance applications.  It can be activated to reveal a small conical area around you.
translations: 一套袖珍成像仪，能够扫描隐藏在墙壁、面板或者其他障碍后面的物体，将其显示在屏幕上。通常用于诊断宇宙飞船内部系统中的潜在故障，但这种透视能力显然还能用于监控。激活以透视周围一小片锥形区域。

messages.msgid: A handheld motion scanner normally used for pest control within spaceships.  This model features an integrated screen to highlight the location of detected motion.  It must be activated to function.
translations: 手持式运动扫描仪通常用于飞船内的害虫控制。 该型号配有一个集成屏幕，可显示检测到的运动位置。 必须激活才能运作。

messages.msgid: This active motion scanner will survey your surroundings every ten seconds and audibly alert you when movement is detected.  Wielding it will accurately reveal the location of motion sources.
translations: 启动的运动传感器每隔十秒扫描一次附近环境，并会在检测到运动时发出提示声。手持它就能发现运动源的精确位置。

messages.msgid: The %s screen flashes briefly before fading out.
translations: %s的屏幕短暂闪烁，然后逐渐暗了下去。

messages.msgid: One of the many versions of UASTA certified plasma torches, essentially a civilian plasma railgun used to deliver focused waves of plasma for precision welding or metal cutting.  It is an indispensable tool for construction or demolition work, and is sometimes transformed into a weapon by mining & salvage outfits of questionable repute.
translations: 经过UASTA认证的众多等离子喷枪版本之一，本质上是一种民用等离子磁轨炮，发射出高度聚焦的等离子射线，用于精密焊接或金属切割。它是建筑或拆除工程中不可或缺的工具，有时也会被名声不好的采矿和打捞团伙改装为武器。

messages.msgid: Your custom crafted atomic smartphone.  Most notably a confidential executive-level override program allows you to remotely control most robots.
translations: 定制版原子智能手机。值得一提的是内部集成了一个保密的高管级重置程序能够让你远程控制大多数机器人。
"鬼神"公司高管智能手机（音乐）

messages.msgid: Rivtech's premiere self-heating kitchen appliance, complete with lid, hand-crafted with the power of the atom to reach any temperature in thirty seconds.  As bulky as it is, its plutonium power source means that it can be used to cook an absurd amount of meals without ever worrying about running low on power.  Unsurprisingly, sales weren't particularly good because of the prospect of irradiating your food, but internal shielding ensures that only trace amounts find their way into the center.
translations: Rivtech有限公司首创的自动加热厨房设备，配有盖子，用原子的力量烹饪食物，可在30秒内达到任何温度。虽然它体积庞大，但它的钚电源意味着它可以用来烹饪大量的食物，而不用担心电量不足。由于担心放射性物质会污染食物，该设备的销售情况不出所料并不特别好，但内部密封确保只有微量放射性物质会进入食物之中。

messages.msgid: A Curie-G coffeemaker, made by CuppaTech.  It famously uses a radioactive generator to heat water for coffee.  Normally the water is heated using energy stored in a capacitor, and makes ordinary coffee.  However, as a special feature, water from the RTG containment area can be used, giving the coffee a very special kick.  The Curie-G is illegal in most countries.
translations: 一台由CuppaTech公司生产的Curie-G型原子咖啡机。因使用放射性元素产生的热量来加热咖啡而闻名。通常情况下，普通的咖啡机是通过电能来加热水冲泡咖啡的。然而，这台特殊的原子咖啡机可以使用内置的放射性同位素热机来加热密封区域的水。Curie-G型原子咖啡机在大多数国家都被禁用。

messages.msgid: A huge, gas-powered saw with a diamond blade.  If it has gasoline, it can be turned on to turn it into a powerful metal cutting tool.
translations: 一种巨大的气动锯，带有金刚石锯片。如果有汽油作为燃料，它就可以变成一个强大的金属切割工具。

messages.msgid: You rev up the power cutter!
translations: 你提高了切割机的转速！

messages.msgid: A huge, gas-powered saw with a diamond blade, currently a whirling blur.  It's consuming gasoline, but can be used as a fantastic tool for cutting metal.  You can also use it as a terrifying weapon, if you're into that sort of thing.
translations: 一个巨大的，气动的钻石锯片，目前正在疯狂旋转。它消耗汽油，可以用来切割金属。如果你喜欢这种东西，你也可以把它当作一种可怕的武器。
你的切割机安静下来了。

messages.msgid: This former power cutter has been lightened and stripped of all those unnecessary safety measures, turning it into a gas-powered killing machine.  Use it to turn it on.
translations: 这台曾经的切割机已经被精简，去掉了所有不必要的安全措施，变成了一台气动杀戮机器。使用它来打开。
你拉高了杀人锯的转速！

messages.msgid: This fearsome weapon is currently whirring loudly and shaking with the force of its own power.  Use it to turn it off.
translations: 这件可怕的武器现在正在用它自己的力量发出巨大的声音和震动。再次使用关闭。
你的杀人锯安静下来了。

messages.msgid: An ignitable device that produces oxygen through an exothermic chemical reaction.  Often stocked as the last backup in case of total life support failure.  You could activate it, but that would just waste it.
translations: 这个可点燃的装置可以通过放热的化学反应产生氧气。通常用于总体维生装置失效时的最后储备。你可以激活它，但这样只会白白浪费。

messages.msgid: This is a unified power supply, or UPS.  It is a device developed jointly by military and scientific interests for use in combat and the field.  The UPS is designed to power armor and some guns, but drains batteries quickly.  It can be worn strapped to either leg for ease of access, and it's been waterproofed to protect the delicate electronics.  Has its own custom battery, rechargeable and with higher capacity, but not removable
translations: 这是一个统一化电源，简称UPS。这种装置由军方和科学界共同研制，用于战斗和野外使用。UPS的设计目的是为动力装甲和某些枪支提供动力，但它的电力会很快耗尽。它可以绑在其中一条腿上以方便取用，而且它经过防水处理，以保护精密的电子元件。内部有特制的电池元件，容量更高而且可充电，但无法移除。

messages.msgid: A set of very small tools and encrypted digital keys normally used to repair bionic modules in clinical settings.  They will allow you to disassemble simple bionics, but anything more complex would require even more specialized tools.
translations: 一整套非常小的工具和加密所用的数字密钥，通常用于在专门诊所中修复生化插件。它们可以让你拆解一些简单的生化插件，但任何复杂的生化插件都需要更专业的工具才能拆解。

messages.msgid: A set of very small robotic tools and encrypted digital keys originally designed to disassemble and test the quality of industrially produced bionics.  A highly skilled and patient engineer could use them to manually assemble new cybernetics.
translations: 一整套非常小的自动化工具和加密所用的数字密钥，通常用于在工厂中拆解和测试生化插件。一个经验丰富且耐心的工程师可以用它手工组装新的生化插件。

messages.msgid: This device replaces standard power connections and battery ports for electronic devices with a carefully-shaped port that hooks into bionic implants.  When applied, it will convert an item to run directly off of bionic power.
translations: 这个设备用一个精心设计的端口取代了电子设备的标准电源连接和电池端口，这个端口可以与生化插件连接。连接后，它可以让物品使用生化能量运行。

messages.msgid: A modified laptop, now additionally capable of transmitting in the ultra-high frequencies utilized by robots.  Activate it to command robots from afar.
translations: 一种改进的笔记本电脑，现在可以和机器人进行超高频信息传输。使用它可以从远处遥控机器人。

messages.msgid: A portable virtual reality rig with glasses for the HUD and the computing functions wrapped around the torso.  When powered on it will provide an overlay on everything you experience.
translations: 一台便携式虚拟现实套装，带有配套的抬头式显示眼镜和包裹在躯干周围的计算装置。通电后，它将能够覆盖你所能够体验到的一切。

messages.msgid: The holosuite comes to life around you.
translations: 全息影像在你周围开始活动。
