messages.msgid: Compact and powerful, the SR-77 serves as the current main firearm of UICA assault teams, having replaced the SR-P9 in the very last decade of the reclamation wars.  Designed for combat withing the tight confines of spacecraft and habitats, the SR-77 is a bullpup carbine with a top-mounted magazine and a high rate of fire.  Performance in open terrain is subpar.

A rare version of the m90-UASTA PDW built to its original private market specifications, featuring an ergonomic bullpup design and a large magazine capacity underneath a sleek white and chromed finish.  Actual combat performance is slightly improved over the more common military model, due to the use of higher-quality materials within the barrel and ETC ignition system.
translations: m90-UASTA个人防卫武器的稀有型号，完全依照最初的民用市场规格打造。它采用人体工学无托设计，弹匣容量可观，通体覆以光滑的白色镀铬涂装。由于枪管和ETC点火系统采用了更高级的材料，它的实战性能也比常见的军用型号略胜一筹。

messages.msgid:
The legendary apex of smartgun technology, believed to be an urban legend by most.  Bleeding-edge targeting systems allow it to track up 10 distinct targets simultaneously, with every trigger pull delivering a burst of two 7.5mm microjet darts to each target with a precision that is best described as supernatural.  One needs only to point the weapon in the general direction of the enemy, and the Vahagn will do the rest.

Prohibitive cost and complexity kept this weapon from ever seeing the light of day, and only a handful of prototypes are believed to exist within the black market.  Finding one here can only mean that corporate forces beyond the ordinary have made Salus IV their battleground.
translations:
智能枪械技术领域的传奇之作，在多数人耳中，它只是个都市传说。其顶尖的瞄准系统可同时锁定多达10个不同目标，每扣动一次扳机，便会向每个目标射出两枚7.5毫米微型导弹，精准度堪称鬼神莫测。枪手只需将它大致指向敌人，剩下的，“瓦哈格恩”自会搞定。

然而，其令人望而却步的成本与复杂性，最终导致该武器胎死腹中，未能面世。据说仅有寥寥数件原型品流入黑市。如今它竟现身此地，这只说明某些超乎寻常的企业势力，已将萨勒斯四号星变成了它们的角斗场。

messages.msgid: Considered overkill by some, the Rivtech M99 remains an exceedingly powerful addition to the arsenal of any gunslinger.
translations: 毫无疑问，Rivtech M99是一款非常暴力的左轮手枪，而且不少人都认为过于暴力了。
车载 一千克等离子磁轨炮

messages.msgid: A stubby industrial tool used to shoot expanding foam.  Using it as a weapon might require some creative thinking.
translations: 一把粗短的产业工具，用来喷射能够迅速膨胀的泡沫水泥。把它当作武器可能需要有一些创意。

messages.msgid: A severed robotic hand from a Wraitheon Sentinel.  The powerful electro-laser stun gun embed on its wrist is still functional, and can be used when connected to an UPS.
translations: 从"鬼神"哨兵机器人上砍下来的一只机械手。腕上嵌入的强力电磁激光眩晕枪仍可使用，当使用UPS供电时可以继续使用。

messages.msgid: A powerful tri-barreled laser weapon, still mounted to the robotic hand of the Wraitheon drone it originally belonged to.  Can still be fired when connected to an UPS.
translations: 一把仍安装在"鬼神"机器人的一只机械手上的三管激光枪。当使用UPS供电时可以继续使用。

messages.msgid: This is an x-ray laser stripped from a TX-5LR Cerberus laser turret that has been modified to use UPS power for firing.  Single shot then requires reloading.  Nicknamed the 'Tin Can Killer' for its ability to destroy power armor.
translations:
一只从 TX-5LR "地狱犬"型激光炮塔上拆下的X射线激光炮。被修改成使用UPS供电。每次射击后需要重新装填。绰号"锡罐杀手"，因为它具有摧毁动力装甲的巨大威力。
"一炮一个罐头人。"

messages.msgid: This is a cheap laser rifle made from common components.  Weak, but can be powered with rechargeable batteries.
translations: 这是一把用常见部件组装而成的简易激光步枪。威力较弱，但可以使用可充电电池供能。

messages.msgid: A common pulse-laser pistol cleared for civilian use.  Recoilless, energy-efficient, and easy to use, the av-22 is often carried as a defense weapon by those who lack the practice required to effectively use ballistic weaponry.  Due to its low power, it must be fired in sequence mode to stand a chance against hardened foes.
translations: 一把可用于民用的激光脉冲手枪。无后坐力，效率高，而且很易用。Av-22主要由缺少需要有效使用兵器的锻炼的人用作防御性武器。因为它的威力很低，所以必须连续发射，才有机会对付强大的敌人。

messages.msgid: A silver, elegantly-wrought laser pistol that fires armor-piercing bolts of golden light.  A now-irreplaceable historical artifact built by the engineering AIs of the late Hyperspace Era, it is as precious as it is deadly.
translations: 一个银色、工艺精良的激光手枪，可以射出穿透装甲的金光。一个超空间时代晚期的工程师们创造的、现在仍无可取代的历史性神器，如同它的致命程度一样珍贵。

messages.msgid: Straight from the bureaus of the old Soviet Union the PLC-75 is the crude and brutal answer to the constraints posed by the design of heavy laser ordnance.  Its use of antiquated flashtube pumped laser technology makes it unwieldy and wholly incompatible with modern equipment, whether this offers any consolation to downrange targets remains a matter of contentious dispute.
translations: PLC-75直接来自古苏联的设计局，是对重型激光武器设计限制的暴力答案。它使用过时的闪光灯管泵浦激光技术，因此非常笨重，与现代设备完全不兼容。

messages.msgid: Crown jewel of Shikishma armories, and possible product of unsanctioned data scavenging, the A-82 is the undisputed market leader when it comes to man portable laser weaponry.  Sustained fire is likely to cause secondary explosions as target layers are vaporized.
translations: A-82激光枪是敷岛军工的明珠，可能属于非法数据挖掘的成果。它在单兵激光武器市场的地位无可匹敌。连续射击可能会蒸发目标材料，制造二次爆炸。

messages.msgid: An incredibly ancient and outdated laser pistol design with origins traceable to Earth's early Space Age.  One of the few 'open-hardware' guns, its leaked and widely-circulated design specifications allow this weapon to retain some popularity within backwater worlds.
translations: 一个不可思议的古老而过时的激光手枪设计，最早可以追溯到太空时代早期。是少数的"开放硬件"枪之一，它的泄露后广为流传的设计规格让这把武器在大灾变后的世界中保留了一些人气。
车载 A7 激光步枪

messages.msgid: This 'energy weapon' appears to be haphazardly jury-rigged from commercially available electronics.  It has a radar dish placed where a barrel would be, and the frame of a weapon is covered in a mesh of wiring.  Despite its appearance, this weapon can temporarily stun robots if you manage to hit their sensors.
translations: 这把"能量武器"似乎是由民用电子设备拼凑而成的。它枪管所在位置安装上了一个雷达天线，武器框架外覆盖满了金属导线。尽管外观如此，如果你能用它精确击中机器人的传感器的话，就能暂时击晕机器人。

messages.msgid: Based on an old TsKBEM design, this is a rail launcher used in mining exploration.  The rod is fired into a rock face and a seismic mapper on the launcher displays ore veins.  Not being designed for combat, it is difficult to use without the augmented strength of an exosuit and the reloading process is quite slow.  The barrel is covered in warning labels indemnifying the manufacturer of any injuries caused by misuse.
translations: 用于采矿勘探的磁轨枪，基于TsKBEM的旧设计。磁轨枪发射探测杆撞击岩壁，然后枪上的地震绘图器就会显示内部矿脉。由于不是为战斗而设计，因此它在没有外骨骼增强力量的情况下很难使用，装弹过程也相当缓慢。枪管上贴有警告标签，如果使用不当造成任何伤害，制造商将不承担赔偿责任。

messages.msgid: This light coilgun fires 3x35mm armor-piercing flechette.  Classified as a support crew weapon that can be stashed in hidden lockers throughout the floors of a ship.  Designed to be fired in short bursts, if the flechettes pierce a ship's hull they leave tiny holes that are easily repaired.
translations: 这是一款发射3x35mm穿甲钢矛弹的轻型线圈枪。定位为支援武器，可藏匿于飞船甲板的暗柜之中。此枪专为短点射设计，其弹药即便洞穿船体，也只会留下易于修复的细小破口。
3x35mm ‘浪行神甫’ 全自动线圈手枪

messages.msgid: An automatic coilgun made entirely of lightweight ceramics, with no moving pieces and if loaded with splinter rounds almost entirely invisible on most security scanners.  No one is sure who manufactures this assassin's tool, but they randomly come onto the back room markets frequented by the unsavory.
translations: 一把全自动线圈枪，通体由轻质陶瓷打造，没有任何活动部件。若是装填碎裂弹，在绝大多数安全扫描仪上都能做到近乎隐形。没人知道这种刺客工具的来路，但它总会神出鬼没地出现在那些三教九流之辈常去的黑市里。

messages.msgid: A heavy plasma railgun that easily defeats most forms of conventional armor and flash-incinerates anything  behind it.  Its large size and liability to overheat make it unsuitable for infantry use, but it is a common sight on military vehicles and in the hands of power-armored troops, especially when heavy armor is expected.
translations: 一门重型等离子磁轨炮可以轻松击败大多数形式的传统装甲，并在闪光下焚烧它背后的任何东西。它的体积大，容易过热，不适合步兵使用，但它在军用车辆上和动力装甲部队手中很常见，特别是在需要重型装甲的情况下。

messages.msgid: A short and stubby 2 gram plasma railgun occasionally used by espatiers as a hull breaching tool.  Like larger plasma weapons, it propels toroids of plasma that detonate on contact, but its reduced size heavily hampers its range and damage output.  Fired within an atmosphere, its very low range makes it dangerous to shooter and target alike.
translations: 一支短粗的两克等离子磁轨炮，偶尔会被星际战士用作破坏船体的工具。同其他更大的等离子武器一样，它会喷射出触碰引爆的等离子环，但它缩减的尺寸严重限制了它的射程和伤害输出能力。在大气中开火时，它极低的射程使得它对射击者和目标都很危险。

messages.msgid:
A common modification for directed plasma torches that involves the installation of oversize capacitor banks and judiciously bypassed safety mechanisms, allowing them to function as a deadly if decidedly short-ranged weapons.  In most cases, the resulting "gun" can still perform its original metalworking functions, albeit at a much lower efficiency.

Unlike purposefully made plasma weapons, the propelled plasma bottle won't cause a considerable explosion upon contact, allowing for relatively safe operation within enclosed spaces.
translations:
一款常见的定向等离子喷枪的改造型号，包括安装了超大电容器组和精心绕过防护机构，使其能够作为致命的短程武器使用。在大多数情况下，这把"枪"仍然可以用于其原始的金属加工功能，尽管效率要低得多。
与专门制造的等离子武器不同，喷气式等离子瓶在撞击时不会引发相当大的爆炸，从而能在封闭空间内进行相对安全的操作。

messages.msgid: Exhaust from a salvaged starship engine is channeled through a series of magnetic coils and focused into a searing fan of plasma, creating a crude but effective short range weapon that can easily melt through most forms of armor.  Its makeshift nature and lack of proper cooling systems make it prone to overheating and catastrophic failure.
translations: 这把武器将回收的星舰引擎废气导入磁线圈，聚焦成一道灼热的扇形等离子体。它是一件粗暴有效的近程武器，能轻易熔穿绝大多数装甲。但由于结构简陋且缺乏必要冷却，此枪极易过热，甚至会引发灾难性故障。

messages.msgid: Bionic one-shot subdermal 10mm pistol integrated with your head.
translations: 通过生化插件植入你头骨的单发10mm手枪。

messages.msgid: A single-shot, break-action, electrically propelled, steel rail launcher handcrafted from scrap.  The hypervelocity metal stake that it fires is accelerated to the point of spontaneous combustion by a Lorentz force generated by electromagnetic induction, powered by a standard UPS.
translations: 一把电力驱动的单发开膛式钢制轨道发射器，采用废金属自制而成。它通过电磁感应所产生的洛仑兹力发射超高速金属棒，同时加热棒体至接近自燃的温度，该武器采用标准UPS供电。

messages.msgid: A widely popular combat shotgun featuring minor iterative refinements to a base design nearly three centuries old.  Whether the design is outdated or unsurpassable remains a matter of personal opinion.
translations: 广受欢迎的战斗霰弹枪，对近三个世纪前的基础设计小修小补的成果。至于这种设计是过时了还是不可超越，则见仁见智。

messages.msgid: A crude but otherwise serviceable pump-action shotgun built from a hacked or scavenged template.  Frequently seen in the hands of frontier pirates, settlers or salvors.  Not that such groups are much different from one another.
translations: 一种粗制滥造但可用的泵动式霰弹枪，来自骇入或挖掘的数据模板。经常出现在边境海盗、定居者或打捞者手中。这些群体本就没什么区别。

messages.msgid: The standard issue combat shotgun of UICA marine and colonial forces.  Shot shells have poor performance against modern combat armor, so the M2101 is more often used during policing and peacekeeping operations.
translations: UICA陆战队和殖民地部队的标准战斗霰弹枪。霰弹对现代护甲的效果较差，因此M2101更常用于治安和维和行动。

messages.msgid: An advanced shotgun that combines chemical and electromagnetic propulsion systems to accelerate and focus a cloud of steel flechettes.  Resulting in a longer effective range and greater penetration than whats conventionally possible.  Most often deployed during low-intensity corporate conflicts.
translations: 一种先进的霰弹枪，融合了化学和电磁推进系统，用于加速并聚焦一团钢质箭弹。这使得其有效射程更长，穿透力更强，超越了传统霰弹枪的性能。这种枪械最常用于低强度的企业冲突中。

messages.msgid: A massive TSKBEM-design shotgun intended for exosuit forces, the Raketa aka 'Rocket' is a magazine-fed bullpup shotgun featuring twin barrels.  This design remains popular for extra-atmospheric operations as the 12ga rounds are less likely to pierce a ship or station's delicate hull.
translations: “火箭”式（Raketa，俄语“火箭”）是TsKBEM设计的大型霰弹枪，主要用于动力装甲部队。12号口径霰弹更不容易击穿飞船或空间站的脆弱壳体，因此在大气外行动中仍然很受欢迎。

messages.msgid: A massive TSKBEM-designed 'sidearm' intended for exosuits and uplifts, the Drotik aka 'Dart' is a large revolver firing 12ga shells.
translations: “镖”式左轮霰弹手枪是TsKBEM为动力装甲和提升动物设计的“副武器”，发射12号霰弹。
海陆安保 T72 霰弹枪

messages.msgid: The single round 00 bore barrel built at the center of the T72 revolver.  Can function as a backup in case the power pack of the main weapon is depleted.
translations: T72左轮枪身中央内置的单发00口径枪管。当主武器能源耗尽时，可充当备用火力。

messages.msgid: Within the solid barrel of the Raaz PROTON, an electrical anomaly is carefully duplicated through magnetic stimulation and projected outwards.  Freed from containment, the anomaly will temporarily settle in the physical world and quickly emit its stored electrical charge before dissipating.
translations: 在 Raaz 质子步枪的固体枪管内，通过电磁刺激精心地复制了一个电磁异常场，并向外发射。在脱离束缚腔后，这种异常电场将暂时在实体世界中立足，并在消散之前迅速释放其中所储存的电荷。

messages.msgid: A powerful anti-drone defense weapon, the W3310 Archangel is capable of firing a chain of electrical discharges that can arc between multiple targets.  Most effective against groups of lightly armored foes, use within closed spaces is not recommended due to the risk of self-inflicted injury.
translations: 作为一种强大的反无人机防御武器，W3310 “大天使 ”能够在多个目标之间发射弧形连锁放电。 该武器对轻型装甲的敌人群体最为有效，但由于有自伤的风险，不建议在封闭空间内使用。

messages.msgid: Wraitheon Armories' premier electrolaser personal defense weapon.  The W3100 Volt adjustable power settings make it adaptable to most conflict situations, lethal or otherwise, and make it a favorite among well-off security forces and law enforcement corps.
translations: 鬼神军械库出品的顶级电激光个人防卫武器。W3100伏的可调电源设置使其适应大多数冲突情况，无论是致命或是其他情况，因此深受富裕的安全部队和执法部队的青眯。

messages.msgid: Custom firmware for the electrical ignition system of caseless firearms.  Tweaks the ignition timing to maximize pressure in the chamber, increasing muzzle velocity and armor penetration at the cost of increased wear on the weapon.
translations: 专为无壳弹枪械电子点火系统设计的定制固件。通过调整点火时机最大化膛压，以提升枪口初速与穿甲威力，代价是会加速武器的磨损。

messages.msgid: Custom firmware for the electrical ignition system of caseless firearms.  Tweaks the ignition timing to ensure that fired bullets remain subsonic, reducing noise at the cost of range and armor penetration.
translations: 专为无壳弹枪械电子点火系统设计的定制固件。通过调整点火时机，确保子弹在射出后保持亚音速飞行，以降低噪音，代价是牺牲了射程和穿甲威力。

messages.msgid: Custom firmware for the electrical ignition system of caseless firearms.  Increases the potency of the heat ignition system, causing bullets to melt and be subsequently fired as globules of superheated metal.  The projectiles will set targets on fire, at the cost of direct damage, range, and weapon durability.
translations: 专为无壳弹枪械电子点火系统设计的定制固件。此固件会增强热点火系统的功率，使弹头在发射瞬间熔化，化为一团团炽热的金属液射出。射弹能点燃目标，但代价是削弱了直接伤害、有效射程并会折损武器耐久。

messages.msgid: A set of high-tech electronics and optics.  This converts a laser pistol into a less-lethal electrolaser capable of stunning targets, at the cost of decreased damage output and increased power consumption.
translations: 一套高科技电路及光学器件。这个改装模组可将激光手枪改装成发射能够击晕目标的非致命电子束激光，但相应的会减少伤害输出，并增加射击时的能量消耗。

messages.msgid: A capacitor with a higher energy density increases range and damage, at the cost of doubling power consumption.
translations: 一个使用了高能量密度材质制成的电容器，能够增加激光武器的射程和伤害，但同时也极大的增加了射击时的能量消耗。

messages.msgid: A choke that uses a powerful cross-shaped electromagnet to pull the shot cloud together, greatly reducing the spread of shot.  Prevents the use of slugs.
translations: 利用十字形的强力电磁铁，可以将霰弹弹丸攒成一团的磁力喉缩，极大降低弹丸散布。安装后将无法使用独头弹。

messages.msgid: A tuned set of electromagnets that accelerate projectiles to a much higher velocity than normal, increasing range and damage.  The required modifications are invasive and cannot be removed once installed.
translations: 这是一组经过精心调整的电磁铁，能将弹丸加速到远超常规的速度，进而大幅提升射程和破坏力。所需的改装极具侵入性，一旦安装便无法拆除。

messages.msgid: The iron sights of this weapon are infamously terrible, making aiming much harder than it needs to be.
translations: 这个武器的机械瞄具出了名的糟糕，瞄准比正常情况慢了许多。

messages.msgid: An advanced ballistic computer calculates projectile trajectories, hit-probabilities, and enemy movements, before outputting the information into an AR holo display.  It greatly increases both accuracy and aiming speed.
translations: 一种先进的弹道计算机，能计算出投射物的轨迹、命中概率以及敌人的运动状态后将信息输出到AR全息显示器上。它会极大地提高精度和瞄准速度。

messages.msgid: An integrated ballistic computer completely replaces the sights of this weapon.  Aiming depends on a small glass screen on which targets are automatically highlighted.
translations: 集成的弹道计算机完全取代了这种武器的瞄具。瞄准依靠一块小玻璃屏，在该屏幕上目标会自动高亮显示。

messages.msgid: A 20-round magazine for use with the Seyfert 84k.
translations: 一个20发弹匣，可用于塞弗特 84K 手枪。

messages.msgid: A magazine for the MarSec handguns.  It holds 14 rounds.
translations: 海陆安保手枪弹匣，可容纳14发子弹。

messages.msgid: A transparent polymer 22-round magazine for Silvergram pattern smart pistols.
translations: 一个22发的透明高分子聚合物弹匣，可用于希瓦格兰智能手枪。

messages.msgid: A 40-round magazine for use with 25mm firearms.
translations: 一个40发弹匣，可用于使用25mm榴弹的武器。

messages.msgid: A 100-round box magazine for use with 5x50mm flechette firearms.  Designated as RMFB100.
translations: 一个100发弹匣，可用于使用5x50mm镖形弹的武器。其官方命名为RMFB100。

messages.msgid: A 50-round box magazine for use with 5x50mm flechette firearms.  Designated as RMFB50.
translations: 一个50发弹匣，可用于使用5x50mm镖形弹的武器。其官方命名为RMFB50。

messages.msgid: A standardized 30-round magazine compatible with most UICA issue rifles.
translations: 一个标准30发弹匣，可用于多数 UICA 制式步枪上。

messages.msgid: A standardized 100-round double drum magazine compatible with most UICA issue rifles.
translations: 一个标准100发弹鼓，可用于多数 UICA 制式步枪上。
海陆安保 T72 快速装弹器（7.50mm）

messages.msgid: A speedloader for the MarSec T72 revolver, holds 9 rounds of 7.50mm ammunition.
translations: 一个海陆安保 T72 左轮手枪专用的快速装弹器，可装填9发 7.50mm 弹。

messages.msgid: A translucent 45-round box magazine, for use with the SR-77.
translations: SR-77专用半透明弹匣，容量45发。

messages.msgid: A large box magazine and accompanying feed chute for the Vahagn 10XR.  Holds 80 rounds of 7.50mm SDART ammunition.
translations: Vahagn 10XR专用的大型弹匣，附带供弹滑槽。可装填80发7.50mm稳定飞镖弹。

messages.msgid: This speedloader, made by Rivtech for use with the RM99 revolver, can hold 5 rounds of 8x40mm caseless rounds and quickly reload a compatible revolver.
translations: 该装弹器由Rivtech公司制造，用于RM99左轮手枪，可容纳5发 8x40mm 无壳弹，为兼容的左轮手枪快速装弹。

messages.msgid: A conical device salvaged from an alien artifact.  Grooves etched on its circular face slowly pulse with purple light.
translations: 从外星人造物中回收来的圆锥形装置。在它圆形表面上刻有数道凹槽，其中不断缓慢闪动着紫色的光。

messages.msgid: A standard-design power cell compatible with most common energy weapons.  Can be recharged by connecting to a power source.
translations: 一个标准的储能装置，能用于大部分常见的能量武器，可通过电源充能。

messages.msgid: A compact power cell compatible with most common energy weapons.  Can be recharged by connecting to a power source.
translations: 一个小型储能装置，能用于大部分常见能量武器，可通过电源充能。

messages.msgid: A functional but poorly-built power cell compatible with most common energy weapons.  It cannot be recharged.
translations: 一个勉强能用的自制储能装置，能用于大部分常见能量武器，但是不可再次充能。

messages.msgid: A thin strip of transuranic metal, glowing a somber blue from within its shielded glass prison.  A rare and sought-after relic, it could be used to momentarily power all sorts of technology from the late Hyperspace Era.
translations: 一条薄薄的超铀金属带，在其屏蔽玻璃的监牢之中散发出阴郁的蓝色光芒。这是一个罕见的、受人追捧的高科技遗物，它可以用来为超空间时代后期的各种科技武器短暂地提供动力。

messages.msgid: A pressurized 5L canister designed to feed an industrial foam gun.
translations: 一个加压的 5L 罐，设计来给泡沫水泥喷射器供料。

messages.msgid: A 150-round box magazine for use with 3x35mm flechette coilguns.  Marketed as GGS150.
translations: 用于3x35mm钢矛弹线圈枪的150发弹匣，市售型号为GGS150。

messages.msgid: A 75-round box magazine for use with 3x35mm flechette coilguns.  Marketed as GGS75.
translations: 一个 75 发弹匣，可用于使用3x35mm镖形弹的线圈枪。其官方命名为GGS75。

messages.msgid: A tiny canister that can safely store up to 4 grams of solid hydrogen in a cryo-pressurized state.
translations: 一个能够安全储存最多4克高压低温固态氢的小罐。

messages.msgid: A reinforced canister that can safely store up to 20 grams of solid hydrogen in a cryo-pressurized state.
translations: 一个能够安全储存最多20克高压低温固态氢的加强罐。

messages.msgid: A yellow and red canister that can safely store up to 40 grams of solid hydrogen in a cryo-pressurized state.  A complex nozzle with integrated digital failsafes make it incompatible with military railguns.
translations: 一个漆着黄色和红色的罐子，可以在低温加压状态下安全储存高达40克的固态氢。带有内置数字故障防护的复杂喷嘴使其无法与军用磁轨炮兼容。

messages.msgid: A removable 30-round horizontal magazine, for use with the Raketa shotgun.
translations: 可拆卸的30发水平弹匣，可用于“火箭”式霰弹枪。

messages.msgid: This speedloader holds up to eight 12ga shotgun shells, intended for use with the Drotik.
translations: 最多可装载8发12号霰弹的快速装弹器，可用于“镖”式霰弹手枪。

messages.msgid: A high-density energy cell purposely made to power voltaic weaponry.
translations: 一种高密度的能量电池，专门为伏特武器提供动力。

messages.msgid: A broken STEED, it looks beyond repair.  At least the atomic core shielding should be intact.
translations: 坏掉的 STEED，看起来已经无法修复了。 至少原子核屏蔽应该完好无损。

messages.msgid: You are an esper, capable of accessing the hidden powers of the human mind.
translations: 你是一名灵能者，能唤醒深藏于人类心智中的潜能。

messages.msgid: The ability to control electricity with your mind.
The ability to move objects without touching them.
The ability to read thoughts and influence others' minds.
translations: 读懂思想并影响他人思想的能力。

messages.msgid: Your strength, coordination, and sensory acuity have been increased through genemod treatments.
translations: 通过基因改造疗程，你的力量、协调性和感官敏锐度都得到了提高。

messages.msgid: Your concentration and memorization abilities have been increased through genemod treatments.
translations: 通过基因改造疗程，你的注意力和记忆力得到了提高。

messages.msgid: Your resistance to disease and infection, as well as your ability to recover from injuries, have been improved through genemod treatments.
translations: 通过基因改造疗程，你的抗病和抗感染能力以及伤后恢复能力都得到了提高。

messages.msgid: The efficiency of your metabolic processes, from the length of your sleep cycle to losing fatigue after exercise, have been improved through genemod treatments.
translations: 通过基因改造疗程，你的睡眠周期，消除疲劳的速率和新陈代谢效率都得到了提高。

messages.msgid: Your physical appearance has been improved through genemod treatments.
translations: 通过基因改造疗程，您的外貌得到了优化。

messages.msgid: A course thick matt of fur, somewhere between a ballistic vest and attic insulation.
translations: 一层厚厚的羊毛，强度介于防弹背心和保温服装之间。

messages.msgid: Your dermis has toughened and thickened to provide additional protection.
translations: 你的真皮层已经变硬，并厚到提供额外的保护。

messages.msgid: Your mannerisms and accent are a dead giveaway that you were raised on Earth.  Whatever your thoughts about the homeworld might be, the simple fact that you can call it home is likely to affect relationships with people liable to care about such things.
translations: 你的举止和口音完全暴露了你是在地球上长大的。无论你对家园世界的想法是什么，你可以称之为家这一简单事实很可能会影响那些需要考虑此类事的人的关系。

messages.msgid: You are a duly sworn law enforcement officer, with jurisdiction that technically extends to the Salus System.  Whether you can find anyone who that matters to is questionable.
translations: 你是一名正式宣誓的执法官，理论上你的管辖权远及整个萨勒斯星系。只不过，在这鬼地方还有没有人认你的身份，那就两说了。

messages.msgid: You are an UICA affiliated private-security professional, with jurisdiction that technically extends to the Salus System.  Whether you can find anyone who that matters to is questionable.
translations: 你是UICA下属的一名私营安保专家，理论上你的管辖权远及整个萨勒斯星系。只不过，在这鬼地方还有没有人买你的账，那就两说了。

messages.msgid: You're a doctor who went out to space and has somehow ended up out on the frontier in the Salus System.  At least out here you get a lot more hands on life or death work compared to the core UICA worlds.
translations: 你是一名闯荡太空的医生，不知怎的流落到了萨勒斯星系的边境地带。好在，跟UICA的核心世界比起来，在这里你起码能亲手处理更多真正攸关生死的急症。

messages.msgid: Some worlds maintained human life but lost technologically advanced civilization.  As these worlds get rediscovered some organizations leave the worlds to develop, while others see a source of cheap labor.  Whether you snuck onto a ship or were Shanghaied onto one you've somehow ended up on the hell that is Salus IV.  At least you have some experience surviving outside of what these spacers call 'civilization'.
translations: 有些世界虽然保住了人类的火种，却丢失了高科技文明。这些世界被重新发现后，有些组织听之任之，有些则把那里当成了廉价劳动力的来源。不管你是偷渡上船，还是被拐上来的，你都稀里糊涂地来到了萨勒斯四号星这个鬼地方。好在，对付这些“太空佬”口中的“文明”之外的险恶环境，你还算有两下子。

messages.msgid: You are a UICA Inspector from a civilized part of space.  You have the authority to investigate under a variety of different legal frameworks, UICA, planetary, corporate, system, pre-Discontinuity legal systems for worlds that have only recently been re-discovered.  All of this means that you are nearly a law unto yourself, though you wonder how much that matters in a place like Salus IV outside of maybe Port Augustmoon.
translations: 你是一名UICA督察，来自所谓的太空文明区。你的授权五花八门，从UICA到行星、企业、星系法律，甚至包括那些刚被重新发现的世界在大灾变前的古老法条，你都能拿来当令箭。说白了，你在这里几乎就是王法。——不过，在萨勒斯四号星这种鸟不拉屎的地方，除了秋月港可能还给你几分薄面，你这“王法”到底有多大用，你自己心里也犯嘀咕。

messages.msgid: As a member of the Astrographic and Gatepoint Division you are responsible for spreading the boundaries of the Frontiers and protecting interstellar travel.  This gives you wide ranging latitude when it comes to addressing threats to interstellar travel.  Does this technically make you a member of UICA's very own secret police?  Yes, yes it does.
translations: 作为天图与星门处的一员，你的职责是拓展边疆疆域，并维护星际航路的安宁。这赋予了你在处理任何航路威胁时极大的自由裁量权。这么说来，你算不算是UICA自家秘密警察的一员？没错，你就是。

messages.msgid: Strange memories of another world overwhelm you…  they fade, but not before you change your genetic structure to suit them.
translations: 对另一个世界的奇怪记忆压倒了你……它们渐渐消逝，但在你改变基因结构以适应它们之前不会消失。

messages.msgid: You feel a desire to trumpet and toot.
translations: 你突然有种想要吹响号角的冲动。

messages.msgid: Your species was created as the ultimate shock troop.  Inherit the earth, pedigree your ancestors, crush the foe.
translations: 你们的种族为成为终极突击队而创造。你们要接管地球，继承祖先血统，击溃敌人。

messages.msgid: Fleshy fronds grown from your scalp function like organic heat sinks.  They allow you to live comfortably within the mi-go atmosphere.
translations: 从头皮上长出的蕨叶就像有机的散热器一般。它们让你能够舒适地生活在米戈大气环境之中。

messages.msgid: You think you know how to instruct your body to process radioactive particles out of itself faster than normal.
translations: 你知道如何让身体比平常更快排出放射性微尘。

messages.msgid: You can instruct your immune system to flush out radioactive particles at an enviable speed.
translations: 你能让你的免疫系统以一种羡煞旁人的速度排出放射性微尘。

messages.msgid: The immune system of these beings transcends anything seen in humanity and appear to be able to target even directed infections such as fungal infestations.
translations: 这些生物的免疫系统超越了存在人类中的任何东西，似乎甚至能够针对定向感染，如真菌侵袭。

messages.msgid: Your body becomes much more efficient at distributing heat from itself.
translations: 你的身体变得能够更有效率地散发自身的热量。

messages.msgid: Your skin has thickened and toughened further, acting as natural armor.  Somewhat reduces wet effects.
translations: 你的皮肤长出能作为天然护甲的粗厚毛皮，能一定程度减少潮湿影响。

messages.msgid: Your skin has thick diamond shaped enamel scutes that both armor your body and allow you to move more smoothly in water.  While difficult to penetrate, it also limits your flexibility.  Greatly reduces wet effects.
translations: 有一层厚重的钻石状釉质鳞片在你皮肤上保护你并使你在水中轻松移动。虽说如此，它也限制了你的灵活性。极大减少潮湿影响。

messages.msgid: You see the world a little differently today.  Intelligence + 1
translations: 你每天对世界的看法都有点新的不同。智力+1

messages.msgid: You are beginning to see a way off this planet.  Intelligence + 2
translations: 你开始看到离开这个星球的方法了。智力+2

messages.msgid: As humans uplifted our pets in the final years this process is lifting you to a new level of intelligence.  Intelligence + 4
translations: 当你从人类被基因擢升成为我们的宠物时，你的智力水平会被提升到一个新的层次。智力+4

messages.msgid: You can see the connections from A to B to C to D.  You look at fellow survivors like you are imagining taking them apart.  Intelligence + 5
translations: 你可以清楚看到从A到B到C到D的各种联系，你看着其他幸存者，开始想象把他们分割解剖开的样子。智力+5

messages.msgid: Today is the day to start juggling.  Dexterity + 1
translations: 今天是个开始玩杂耍的日子。敏捷+1

messages.msgid: You are starting to move like they do.  Dexterity + 2
translations: 你开始像它们一样移动。敏捷+2

messages.msgid: You no longer move like a human, others find it disconcerting.  Dexterity + 4
translations: 你不再像人类一样移动，其他人开始感到不安。敏捷+4

messages.msgid: You see some new muscles that you aren't sure you've seen on humans before.  Strength + 1
translations: 你看到身体长出了一些新的肌肉，你不确定你以前在人类身上见过。力量+1

messages.msgid: Fibrous tissue seems to be spreading through your body.  Strength + 2
translations: 这种纤维组织似乎正在你的体内扩散。力量+2

messages.msgid: Your ears have split into a series of tuberous projections.  They waggle towards far away sounds.
translations: 你的耳廓分裂成一系列的块状突起。它们会随着远处的声音摇动。

messages.msgid: When were you ever like these creatures, helpless before the changes ravaging this world.
translations: 你什么时候像过这些生物，在这个世界的变化面前孤独无助。

messages.msgid: You have a sinister aspect to your demeanor, no longer part of this world.  You feel no sorrow at the deaths of humans and your brain now processes combat skills more efficiently as you mentally dissect your opponents.
translations: 你的行为举止有一种邪恶的感觉，仿佛不再是这个世界的一部分。你不会为人类的死亡感到悲伤，你的大脑现在处理战斗技能的效率更高，因为你会在脑中不断地解剖你的对手。

messages.msgid: The death throes of this world are the birthing pangs of yours.
translations: 这个世界的临终挣扎，正是你那世界诞生时的阵痛。

messages.msgid: Your sweat now smells otherworldly, and not in a good way.  The mi-go still hate you but at least they aren't offended by your smell.
translations: 你的汗水现在闻起来仿佛来自异界，特别恶心。米戈仍然恨你，但至少他们不会被你的气味冒犯。

messages.msgid: You are off-putting to others.  Your mannerisms have changed as if human interaction is becoming foreign.
translations: 你总是在冒犯别人。你的行为举止已经改变了，人类之间的互动正在变得让你感到陌生。

messages.msgid: You have a pair of large, veiny wings.  They don't appear to be made for this atmosphere but they grant a powerful buffeting attack.
translations: 你有一对又大又细的翅膀。它们似乎不是为这种大气而生的，但它们让你能够进行威力强大的拍打攻击。

messages.msgid: You can now breathe the gasses the mi-go thrive in.
translations: 你现在可以呼吸让米戈茁壮生长的气体了。

messages.msgid: You come from uplifted animal stock.  This decreases morale penalties for being wet.
translations: 你起源自某种被基因擢升的动物。减少湿身带来的心情惩罚。

messages.msgid: You are capable of carrying far more than someone with similar strength could.  Your maximum weight carried is increased by 60%.
translations: 你背部肌肉力量比普通人更大，你的身体最大承载重量上升60%。

messages.msgid: Your skin has patches of light fur.  This has no impact on your life except marking you as not fully human.
translations: 你的皮肤上有几块浅色毛皮。这除了表明你不是纯粹的人类之外，对你的生活没有任何影响。

messages.msgid: Your feet have grown massive and ready to support huge weight.  This allows kicking attacks to do much more damage, provides natural armor, and removes the need to wear shoes; however, you cannot wear normal size shoes.  Reduces wet effects.
translations: 你的脚已经长得很大了，可以承受很大的重量。踢人更痛，提供天然护甲，光着脚也能走路；然而，你穿不上正常大小的鞋子。减少湿身心情惩罚。

messages.msgid: You kick %s with your massive feet
You have a pair of bumps on your face above your mouth and beside your nose.
translations: 你的嘴唇上方，鼻子旁边有一对突起。

messages.msgid: You have a pair of small tusks on your face.  They allow you to make a weak piercing goring attack.
translations: 你的脸上有一对小象牙。你可以利用它们对敌人造成微弱的戳刺伤害。

messages.msgid: You have a pair of long, pointed tusks, like someone weaponized an elephant.  They allow you to make a strong piercing headbutt attack, but prevent wearing mouthgear that is not made of fabric.
translations: 你有一对又长又尖的象牙，就像全副武装的大象一样。你可以用你的头撞击对方造成刺击伤害，但也让你无法使用不是织物做的嘴部装备。

messages.msgid: You stab %s with your pointed tusks!
Your face resembles that of an elephant, with a significant trunk.  It looks fierce but prevents wearing mouthgear.  Prehensile and able to perform some fine detail work.
translations: 你的脸像大象一样，有一个很大的鼻子。它看起来很凶猛，但令你无法使用嘴部装备。它可抓握并能完成一些精细的工作。

messages.msgid: Your hands have fused into three-fingered paws.  Fine manipulation is a challenge: permanent hand encumbrance of 10, difficulty with delicate craftwork, and your gloves don't fit.  But they handle water better.
translations: 你的双手变成了三趾爪子。精细操作对你来说是个挑战：手部累赘永久+10，精细制造时间延长，手套也不再合身。不过，爪子划水还不错。

messages.msgid: You have a trumpeting, elephantine voice.  Threatening NPCs will be easier, but lying will be very hard.
translations: 你有一副号角般的象鼻嗓音。从而很难对他人撒谎，但威胁他们要容易得多。

messages.msgid: Genetic tampering made your body incredibly strong.  Strength + 7.
translations: 基因突变使你的身体变得异常强壮。力量+7。

messages.msgid: An experimental cryosleep procedure has permanently altered your body, allowing you to better tolerate cold temperatures.
translations: 一次实验性的冷冻休眠程序永久地改变了你的身体，让你能更好地忍受低温。

messages.msgid: You have a natural talent for leadership and can easily see yourself in others.  Quite literally.  In fact, you can swap control to any other character that follows you.
translations: 你天生有领导才能，很容易在别人身上看到自己。字面意思。其实你可以操控任何跟随你的同伴。

messages.msgid: You took the bionic skullgun out of your noggin, but that didn't replace the brain cells you lost when you installed it.
translations: 你把生化头骨枪从脑袋里拿了出来，但那并不能取代你装上它时失去的脑细胞。

messages.msgid: A wave of cold runs through your body and you feel dizzy
translations: 一股寒流流过你的身体，你觉得头有点晕。

messages.msgid: The effects of Sadie's injection appear to be wearing off now
translations: 萨迪注射药剂的效果现在看来正在消退。

messages.msgid: Several hundred lines of text list a series of complex biological molecules with unknown interactions.  Many appear to be associated with healing and immune response.  Only a few are known to be poisonous and many are known carcinogens.  Several have psychological and hormonal effects.
translations: 文本列出了数百行复杂的生物分子及其未知的相互作用。其中许多分子似乎与伤口愈合及免疫反应相关；仅有少数已知有毒，但有相当一部分是公认的致癌物。另有几种会对精神与内分泌系统产生影响。

messages.msgid: This NPC could tell you about how they survived the Cataclysm
translations: 这个人可以告诉你他们是如何在大灾变中幸存下来的。

messages.msgid: Installed on your back is a set of retractable, reinforced solar panels resembling angular butterfly wings.  When in direct sunlight, they will automatically deploy and slowly recharge your power level.
translations: 你的背上安装了一排像蝴蝶翅膀的可伸缩太阳能面板。当你站在阳光下时，它们会自动伸出并缓慢为你充能生化能量。

messages.msgid: An implanted fusion reactor with its own internal nuclear fuel reservoir.  It will last over a century without servicing.
translations: 一种植入式聚变反应堆，自带内部核燃料储备。无需任何维护便可持续运行超过一个世纪。

messages.msgid: Pre-Discontinuity bionic module that was implanted into elite drop troops who could jump from their insertion vehicle during the radar disruption of reentry.  Clenching your fist allows you to activate what scientists call a grav chute that allows a safe fall; while active, the field will prevent damage to your body from severe impacts, at the cost of impaired movement.  It's best not to think about how many bodies this has been in before yours.
translations: 大灾变前的生化插件，被植入精英星际伞兵，在空投时的雷达干扰段，精英星际伞兵可以从空投舱上跳下。握紧拳头可以启动科学家们称之为"重力伞"的力场，从而实现安全降落；开启时，重力场将防止严重撞击对身体造成损害，但会影响运动能力。最好不要去想在植入你体内之前它以及被植入了多少其他的身体之中。

messages.msgid: Your right hand can fold inward to reveal a mechanism capable of igniting and firing 40mm grenades across medium distances.
translations: 你的右手可以向内折叠，露出一个能在中距离发射40毫米榴弹的炮口。

messages.msgid: The left hemisphere of your brain has been augmented with a microcomputer that moderately increases the speed that language and written words are processed, granting a 15% increase to reading speed.
translations: 你的大脑左半球已经被一台微型计算机所增强，它适度地提高了语言和文字处理的速度，使阅读速度提高了15%。

messages.msgid: Tiny cybernetic stimulators have been installed throughout your ventral tegmental area, and trigger at set intervals using bionic power.  This slowly releases a stream of reward chemicals and hormones into your brain, inducing a state of euphoria that notably elevates mood.
translations: 你大脑的腹侧被盖区植入了微型自动刺激电极，并消耗生化能量定期激发。这会在你脑中缓慢释放出一股激励化学物质和荷尔蒙，让你感到极度快乐，这会显著地提升你的心情。

messages.msgid: The interior of your femurs have been scrapped clean, the marrow replaced with a Mercurial brand bio-factory that produces high efficiency blood analogues.  The blood substitutes are fine-tuned for combat, increasing stamina, disease resistance and clotting speed.
translations: 你的股骨被彻底掏空，里面的骨髓换成了“墨丘利”牌的生物工厂，能够生产高效的血液替代品。这些替代品专为战斗而优化，能提升你的耐力、疾病抗性与血液凝结速度。

messages.msgid: Your blood is laced with neuron-analogue nanites, allowing your entire circulatory system to function as a secondary brain.  This radical modification increases your intelligence, reflexes and perception by 4, increases your pain tolerance and allows you to survive brain damage that would otherwise prove fatal.
translations: 你的血液中注入了仿神经元纳米机器人，使你的整个循环系统能作为次级大脑运作。这项颠覆性的改造能让你的智力、反应和感知各提升4点，同时提高你的疼痛耐受力，并让你在遭受致命脑损伤时得以幸存。

messages.msgid: An implanted AI module calculates the optimal followup to each of your melee strikes, allowing you to chain them with unnatural speed and grace.  This bionic must be active to function.
translations: 你体内被植入了一个人工智能系统，能够在你的每次近战攻击后执行最优化的后续行动，让你以非自然的速度和优雅的姿势衔接每次攻击。这个生化插件仅在激活时生效。

messages.msgid: An implanted AI module and medication dispenser calculates the optimal chemical mix to keep you on your toes and ready for combat.  This bionic must be active to function and while it functions your body is at a heightened performance but if it turns off it will take you several days to get back to normal.  There are a significant number of baseline bonuses granted by this setup but people around will notice your junkie behavior.
translations: 植入的人工智能模块和药物分施装置计算出最佳的化学混合物，让你保持时刻警觉和战斗准备。这个仿生体必须处于开启状态才能发挥作用。当它发挥作用时，你的身体性能提升，但如果它关闭，你将需要几天时间才能恢复正常。这种设备有大量的基础能力奖励，但周围的人将注意到你的吸毒行为。

messages.msgid: The chemical injection system and microcomputer that when activated greatly enhances your reaction times and overall speed.  Upon deactivation, the user may experience dizziness, heart palpitations and ravenous appetites.
translations: 化学注入系统和微型计算机在激活后可大大提高反应时间和整体速度。但是一旦停用，使用者可能会感到头晕、心悸和强烈的食欲。

messages.msgid: The chemical injection system and microcomputer that when activated gives a burst of chemicals that allows your blood to work a little harder at stabilizing the body and then flushes your system with a powerful anesthetic that allows you to continue operating at high capacity.  Upon deactivation, the user may experience extreme lethargy, sudden loss of consciousness, among other symptoms that may prove potentially fatal if not in a safe location.
translations: 化学注射系统和微型计算机在激活后会释放出大量化学物质，使血液更加努力地工作以稳定身体状况，然后使用强效麻醉剂冲刷你的生理系统，让你能够继续高效运转。但是一旦停用，使用者可能会出现极度嗜睡、突然失去意识等症状，如果处于危险位置，这些症状可能会致命。

messages.msgid: A battered and used Compact Bionics Module that increases your power capacity by 50 kJ.  Having at least one of these is a prerequisite to using powered bionics.  You will also need a power supply, found in various CBMs.
translations: 一套曾被植入过的，残缺的小型生化电池插件，可以为你增加 50kJ 的生化能量储备上限。你至少需要一个储能模块才能使用耗能型生化插件，同时你还需要至少一种供能型生化插件，为自己充能。

messages.msgid:
Imagine a computer inside your body playing pong against the universe.  The paddles are made of -color glass condensate- and any and all of their specific functions are the intellectual property of the Hawking Corporation and/or its local subsidiaries.
-From the owners manual of HawkingCorps Mark I Shield.

Activating the shield will create an energy shield capable of negating a modest amount of damage from weak or improvised weapons.
translations:
想象一下，你体内的电脑正在跟整个宇宙打一场“乓”游戏。球拍由-彩色玻璃凝聚态-构成，其任何及所有具体功能均为霍金公司及/或其当地子公司的知识产权。
——摘自《霍金公司I型护盾用户手册》。

激活此护盾将产生一道能量屏障，能够抵消来自低威力武器或简易武器所造成的少量伤害。

messages.msgid: A powerful shielding system salvaged from a pre-Discontinuity robotic warframe, crudely adapted for compatibility with biological hosts.  Powerful enough to withstand prolonged assault from anti-vehicle weaponry.
translations: 一套强大的护盾系统，回收自大灾变前的机器人战争框架，并经过粗略改造以兼容生物宿主。其强度足以承受反载具武器的持续攻击。

messages.msgid: An experimental teleportation system carefully weaved into bone marrow and alongside your skeletal system.  Allows you to safely and readily teleport toward previously activated telepads.
translations: 一套实验性的传送系统，被精心植入你的骨髓，缠绕在骨骼系统周围。它能让你安全便捷地传送到一处先前激活的远程传送平台上。

messages.msgid: You've worked for some nasty people.  People who installed a bomb at the top of your spine.  They are all dead now but there is unfortunately a dead man switch if you don't check in roughly every thirty days.  Those thirty days are almost up but you can't remember exactly how many are left.  You need this out and fast.
translations: 你曾经为一些可怕的人工作过。那些人在你颅脑里安装了一个炸弹。他们现在都死了，但不幸的是，如果你30天内没向他们报告就会触发炸弹的自毁装置。30天的时间快到了，但你记不清还剩多久，你需要尽快把这玩意取出来。

messages.msgid: Described in design documents as emergency insulation to protect against exposure to hard vacuum, this CBM is also useful in any encounter that causes instant frostbite.
translations: 在设计文档中，这种生化插件被称为紧急隔热器，用于防护暴露在强真空中时的冻伤，这种CBM也可以用于任何可能导致瞬间冻伤的场合。

messages.msgid: The superheated bionic weapon cuts and burns with ease.
translations: 这件超高温生化武器能轻易地切割并灼烧目标。

messages.msgid: Your bionic weapon sparks under constant electrical charge.
translations: 你的生化武器在持续的电荷作用下迸发着电火花。

messages.msgid: Concealed in your head is a single shot 10mm pistol.  Activate the bionic to fire and reload the skullgun.
translations: 你的头部藏有一把 10mm 口径单发手枪。启动生化插件即可发射头骨枪并重新装弹。

messages.msgid: You have a license to own and operate military grade weaponry and can legally purchase such items without any difficulty.
translations: 你拥有军用级武器的持用许可，可以毫无困难地合法购买此类物品。

messages.msgid: You are capable of holding the same thing in mind even when sitting in an uncomfortable position or after skipping a meal.
translations: 即使坐姿难受或者没有进食，你也能维持一样的思绪。

messages.msgid: You can maintain your concentration even if outside in winter without a coat or in the middle of a fight.
translations: 即使是赤身裸体站在冬天的户外亦或是与丧尸血拼时，你仍能保持专注。

messages.msgid: You can maintain your concentration even when suffering crippling injuries or while on mind-altering substances.
translations: 即使在遭受严重伤害或服用改变思维的物质时你也仍能保持专注。
你的动作有如机器一般精准。
%1$s的动作有着机器人般的精准。

messages.msgid: Creates several short-lived holograms around you.
translations: 在你四周创造出几个持续时间很短的全息投影。
创造出一个持续时间很短的全息投影。

messages.msgid: Causes an existing hologram to explode into burning light, harming and stunning enemies close to it.
translations: 让一个已有的全息影响爆炸成炫目的光芒，伤害并晕眩它附近的敌人。

messages.msgid: Allows you to swap places with a previously existing holographic image of yourself.  If the universe itself can't tell you apart, who could?
translations: 让你能够和已存在自身的全息投影交换位置。如果宇宙本身无法区分你们，谁还能呢？

messages.msgid: Take to the skies with a rocket assisted jump or dash.  You might target a hostile creature to perform a powerful rocket kick at the end of the dash.  The rocket pack allows for a brief moment of air control or hovering after a jump.
translations: 进行火箭辅助的短距离跳跃或空中冲刺。你可以在冲刺结束时以一个敌对生物为目标，给它来一脚威力强大的火箭踢。火箭背包可以在跳跃后进行短暂的空中控制或悬停。

messages.msgid: Translocates the user to an encoded buoy.
translations: 将使用者传送到一个已编码的位标。

messages.msgid: Slowly translocates the user to an encoded buoy.
translations: 缓慢地将使用者传送到一个已编码的位标。

messages.msgid:
End your concentration on all of your maintained powers.

Channeling this power <color_green>always succeeds</color>.
translations:
结束对所有维持的灵能的专注。

引导这种灵能<color_green>总是成功</color>。

messages.msgid:
Open your senses to the flow of electricity, revealing nearby electrical creatures or robots.

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.
translations:
开始尝试感受电流的流动，定位附近的带电生物或机器人。

此项灵能<color_yellow>需要专注维持</color>，可能<color_red>失效</color>于<color_yellow>打断专注</color>后。

messages.msgid: Unleash a shock when touching a target, doing a small amount of damage and dazing them.
translations: 对接触到的目标释放一道电击，造成少量伤害并使其眩晕。
在你的手上有电流噼啪跳动。

messages.msgid: Build up a charge in your body, zapping anyone who attempts to attack you in melee.  It will also protect you from EMP attacks.
translations: 在你的体内积聚电荷，在近战时电击任何试图攻击你的人。这还能保护你免受电磁脉冲的攻击。

messages.msgid:
Create an electrical interface with your powers, allowing you to hack nearby devices as if you were using a computer.

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.
translations:
用灵能创建一个电子接口，让你可以像使用电脑一样破解附近的电子设备。

此项灵能<color_yellow>需要专注维持</color>，可能<color_red>失效</color>于<color_yellow>打断专注</color>后。

messages.msgid:
Generate power for UPS compatible devices on your person.

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.
translations:
产生电流为你兼容UPS的设备充电。

此项灵能<color_yellow>需要专注维持</color>，可能<color_red>失效</color>于<color_yellow>打断专注</color>后。

messages.msgid: Turn your own energy into power for a vehicle or appliance.  You need merely touch the vehicle or any part of the power grid to recharge the batteries.
translations: 将体内的灵能转化为车辆或设备的电力。触摸车辆或电网的任何部位即可进行充电。
灵能流进了你的目标之中。

messages.msgid: Move a set of items towards or away from you.
translations: 将一组物品朝你移动或者移走。

messages.msgid: Shove a target away or pull it towards you with a burst of psionic force.  The distance the target can be moved depends on its weight versus your power level; heavier things will not go as far, and if your target is too heavy, you may not be able to move it at all.
translations: 用一股灵能将目标生物推开或拉向你。目标可以移动的距离取决于它的重量与你的灵能等级；更重的物品不会被移动得太远，如果你的目标太重，你可能根本无法移动它。

messages.msgid:
Edit the momentum of yourself and nearby objects to your benefit, slowing damaging force and slightly increasing your speed.

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.
translations:
操控自己和附近物体的动量，以获取战斗优势，减少受到的伤害并略微增加你的速度。

此项灵能<color_yellow>需要专注维持</color>，可能<color_red>失效</color>于<color_yellow>打断专注</color>后。

messages.msgid: Unleash a telekinetic wave around you that indiscriminately knocks everything back.
translations: 在你周围释放一股心灵震波，不分青红皂白地将一切击退。
你操控念力波击退周围的一切事物！

messages.msgid: Smash a single target or small area with a fist of telekinetic force.
translations: 用灵能砸击单个目标或小片区域。

messages.msgid: You smash your target with a fist of force.
translations: 你使用灵能砸击你的目标。

messages.msgid:
You can protect your mind from the dangers of Salus IV.

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.
translations:
你可以保护自己的心智，免受萨勒斯四号星的危险侵扰。

此能力需要<color_yellow>集中精神来维持</color>，若<color_yellow>专注中断</color>则可能<color_red>失效</color>。

messages.msgid:
You can use your powers to detect the tell-tale hum of a living, sapient mind, no matter how strange or alien it may be.

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.
translations:
你可以利用你的灵能来察觉到一个有生命、有智慧的思维的微弱嗡鸣声，无论它多么奇怪或陌生。

此项灵能<color_yellow>需要专注维持</color>，可能<color_red>失效</color>于<color_yellow>打断专注</color>后。

messages.msgid:
You can subtly influence the thoughts of others, making them more amenable to your point of view.

This power <color_yellow>is maintained by concentration</color> and <color_red>may fail</color> if <color_yellow>concentration is interrupted</color>.
translations:
你可以潜移默化地影响他人的思想，让他们更容易接受你的观点。

此能力需要<color_yellow>集中精神来维持</color>，若<color_yellow>专注中断</color>则可能<color_red>失效</color>。

messages.msgid: Disconnect a target's brain from its senses, leaving it blinded and confused.
translations: 切断目标的大脑与其感官的连接，使其失明和困惑。

messages.msgid: You lock your target's mind away!
The is the part of the Sensory Deprivation that blinds the target.  It's a bug if you have it.
translations: 意识剥夺能力的一部分，使目标失明。拥有这个能力说明你出bug了。

messages.msgid: Short-circuit and overwhelm a target's brain, causing extreme damage or death.  Does not work on targets without living minds, such as robots.
translations: 使目标的大脑短路并过载，造成巨大伤害乃至死亡。对机器人等没有活体心智的目标无效。

messages.msgid: You assault the mind of your target!
A sturdy, lightweight frame made from titanium.  Useful for crafting.
translations: 一个由钛制成的坚固、轻便的框架。可以用来制造物品。

messages.msgid: A sturdy, lightweight foldable frame made from titanium.
translations: 一个由钛制成的坚固、轻便的可折叠框架。用于制造载具。

messages.msgid: A large and complex piloting station from a military vehicle, including a camera station, steering tools, and electronics controls.
translations: 一台军用载具所使用的巨大而复杂的驾驶工作站，包括摄像站、转向工具和电子控制装置。

messages.msgid: This solar panel is obviously cutting-edge technology and given where you found it, it should probably provide a LOT of power.  It's covered in strange-looking material, but the covering looks rather fragile; it doesn't look like it could support a reinforcing sheet, either.
translations: 这种太阳能电池板是尖端技术的产物，拥有极高的光电转换效能。但是它表面覆盖特殊材料让它非常脆弱，同时也无法进行强化加固。

messages.msgid: A small, portable plutonium reactor.  Handle with great care!
translations: 小型便携式钚反应堆，请轻拿轻放！

messages.msgid: This is little more than a sheet metal basin welded to the bottom of the vehicle, extending below it.  Though it holds a lot of stuff, its shoddiness makes it fragile.
translations: 一个将薄钢板焊在车底向下凸出的金属盆。尽管它能装很多东西，但粗劣的焊接工艺使其结构脆弱。

messages.msgid: A piece of sheet metal welded onto a vehicle as armor.  Thin, and not as protective as proper armor, but it'll do if there's nothing else available.
translations: 一片被焊接在载具外侧的薄钢板。太薄了以至于没法像正规装甲那么有效，但总比没有好。

messages.msgid: A large and complex dashboard mounted with steering controls and several LCD touch screens for controlling vehicle systems.
translations: 一个巨大而复杂的仪表板，装有转向控制器和几块LCD触摸屏。你可以用它来控制载具。

messages.msgid: An ultralight titanium framework.  Other vehicle components can be mounted on it, and it can be attached to other frames to increase the vehicle's size.
translations: 一个超轻的钛合金框架。其他载具部件能够安装在它上面，在它四周增加新的车辆框架，就可以增加车辆大小。

messages.msgid: An ultralight titanium foldable framework.  Other vehicle components can be mounted on it, and it can be attached to other frames to increase the vehicle's size.
translations: 一个超轻的可折叠钛合金框架。其他载具部件能够安装在它上面，在它四周增加新的车辆框架，就可以增加车辆大小。

messages.msgid: An extremely high-performance solar panel.  Will recharge the vehicle's electrical power when exposed to the sun.  Clouds will slow the recharge speed.  Extremely fragile and cannot be armored.
translations: 一块超高性能太阳能板。当暴露于阳光照射之下时，会缓慢地为车辆电池充电。云层遮挡会让充电速度更慢。非常容易损坏，且不能安装装甲。

messages.msgid: A small nuclear reactor.  When loaded with plutonium cells and turned on, will generate a lot of electrical power.
translations: 一台微型核反应堆。装入钚电池并开启后，能够为车辆提供许多电力。

messages.msgid: A cargo space for carrying robots.  'e'xamine it to capture a robot next to you, or to release the robot currently contained.  When selecting a robot to capture, choose its tile relative to you, not the part.
translations: 一个运输机器人的货舱。按"e"查看该部件选择需要装载的机器人，或者卸下机器人。当选择装载机器人时，机器人需要紧挨着你。

messages.msgid: You blast a cone of frigid air toward the target.
translations: 向目标发射一股锥形的极寒空气。

messages.msgid: This is a crafting_pseudo_item if you have it something is wrong.
translations: 这是一个虚拟物品，正常不应该出现在你的游戏里。

messages.msgid: Prepared the way into the galaxy.
Prepared the way into the galaxy.

translations: 黑森林熊人队长，食人族

messages.msgid: Like most people on Earth you have previously received cybernetic enhancement to make life easier.  Your enhancements include a universal data link, some basic power storage, and a charging cable to top up.

Were you a mercenary, a criminal, a pirate or a very dedicated adrenaline junkie?  Whatever you were before, now you've got a speed freak rig pumping drugs into your veins 24/7.  Statistically you'll die young, your body burned out by all the drugs, but what other chance did you have to become an immortal legend?  None.
translations: 你是雇佣兵、罪犯、海盗还是肾上腺素上瘾者？不管你以前是什么，现在你被人称为速度怪胎，每天24小时不间断地将毒品注入你的血管。从统计数据来看，你会英年早逝，你的身体会被各类毒品烧毁，但不这样做你有多少可能成为不朽的传奇？毫无机会。

messages.msgid: Your mannerisms and accent are a dead giveaway that you were raised on Earth.  Whatever your thoughts about the homeworld might be, the simple fact that you can call it home is likely to affect relationships with people liable to care about such things.
translations: 你的举止和口音完全暴露了你是在地球上长大的。无论你对家园世界的想法是什么，你可以称之为家这一简单事实很可能会影响那些需要考虑此类事的人的关系。

messages.msgid: You have a license to own and operate military grade weaponry and can legally purchase such items without any difficulty.  A privilege usually reserved for the politically or economically favored.
translations: 你有一张可以合法持有并操作军用武器的许可证，并且可以毫无困难地合法购买此类物品。通常是为政治或经济上出人头地的人所保留的特权。

messages.msgid: You have ample experience working in space, either on a station or on a ship.  You are familiar with safety protocols, capable of piloting small shuttlecraft and can operate and perform maintenance on a variety of space equipment and colony systems.
translations: 你有丰富的太空工作经验，无论是在空间站还是在星舰上。你熟悉安全规范，能够驾驶小型航天器，并可以操作和维护各种太空设备和殖民地系统。

messages.msgid: You have a natural talent for leadership and can easily see yourself in others.  Quite literally.  In fact, you can swap control to any other character that follows you.
translations: 你天生有领导才能，很容易在别人身上看到自己。字面意思。其实你可以操控任何跟随你的同伴。

messages.msgid: Much more common in the Hyperspace Era, the rich or those from Earth still have access to genemodding technology designed to make humanity better.  This is the suite of improvements to increase strength, coordination, and sensory ability as well as fix problems such as nearsightedness.
translations: 即使在超空间时代，有钱人或来自地球的人仍然有机会获得基因改造，以进行对作为人类的自己的优化。 这套改造技术可以增强力量、协调性和感官敏锐能力，还能解决近视等问题。

messages.msgid: Much more common in the Hyperspace Era, the rich or those from Earth still have access to genemodding technology designed to make humanity better.  This is the suite of improvements to increase mental flexibility and memorization.
translations: 即使在超空间时代，有钱人或来自地球的人仍然有机会获得基因改造，以进行对作为人类的自己的优化。 这套改造技术可以增强思维灵活性和记忆力。

messages.msgid: Much more common in the Hyperspace Era, the rich or those from Earth still have access to genemodding technology designed to make humanity better.  This is the suite of improvements to health, providing increased healing speed and resistance to disease and infection.
translations: 即使在超空间时代，有钱人或来自地球的人仍然有机会获得基因改造，以进行对作为人类的自己的优化。 这套改造技术可以增强恢复速度和抗病、扛感染能力。

messages.msgid: Much more common in the Hyperspace Era, the rich or those from Earth still have access to genemodding technology designed to make humanity better.  This is the suite of improvements to recovery, allowing a quicker sleep cycle and faster return to baseline after exertion.
translations: 即使在超空间时代，有钱人或来自地球的人仍然有机会获得基因改造，以进行对作为人类的自己的优化。 这套改造技术可以加快睡眠周期，并在劳累后更快地恢复状态。

messages.msgid: Much more common in the Hyperspace Era, the rich or those from Earth still have access to genemodding technology designed to make humanity better.  This is the suite of improvements to physical appearance, offering clearer skin, more striking features, increased facial symmetry, and removing signs of aging.
translations: 即使在超空间时代，有钱人或来自地球的人仍然有机会获得基因改造，以进行对作为人类的自己的优化。  这是一套改善外貌的技术，能让皮肤更干净、五官更迷人、面部更对称，并能消除衰老迹象。

messages.msgid: Some long-distant member of your family received psi treatments during the Hyperspace Era and somehow it stuck in their DNA.  Always unpredictable, skipping multiple generations at a time, that inheritance has been passed down to you.  You have no training and little idea what you're doing, but you've developed a trick or two.
translations: 不知哪一代的老祖宗曾在超空间时代接受过灵能疗法，其影响不知怎地就刻进了基因里。这份天赋的传承总是难以预测，时常会隔上好几代人才显现一次，而现在，它传到了你的身上。你未受过任何训练，对自己拥有的力量也知之甚少，但总归是摸索出了一两个小窍门。

messages.msgid: A skilled ship technician, turned to independent salvage work.
translations: 一名经验丰富的星舰技师，转向独立回收打捞工作。

messages.msgid: You were a junior crewmember on a freight spaceship.  Without any exceptionally valuable abilities, you spent your workshifts performing miscellaneous maintenance tasks within the ship.  As such, you are moderately skilled at performing all sorts of minor electrical and mechanical repairs, a skillset you hope remains useful planetside…
translations: 你是货运飞船里的初级船员。在没有任何特别有价值的能力的情况下，你用轮班时间在船上执行各种各样的维护任务。因此，你在对各种小型电气设备和机械设备的维修方面有不错的技能，你希望这套技能在当地星球上仍然有用……

messages.msgid: You are a well experienced mercenary espatier, a soldier rated for both orbital and planetary combat.  Until the crash, you were part of a minor mercenary outfit that provided on-board and landing-site security for freight corporations, although it seems that your last contractor required more protection than what you could provide.  Unfortunately, most of your more specialized gear was left behind in your hasty evacuation…
translations: 你是一名经验丰富的雇佣星际战士，一名能在轨道及行星上战斗的士兵。在坠机之前，你是一个小型雇佣兵组织的一员，为货运公司提供飞船上和降落点的安全保障，不过看来你最后的雇主所需要的保护比你能提供的要多。不幸的是，在你仓促撤离的过程中，你大部分更专业的装备都落下了……

messages.msgid: Several years ago, you were newly stationed at a remote corporate facility when it came under a personality rewrite attack that affected all of your human coworkers.  It had seemed likely that the few Uplifted staff would perish and most did.  But you disappeared into the wilderness surrounding the facilities and began hunting the things that had been your friends, eating them to stay alive and to power your bionics.  Recapturing the facility earned you a buyout of the remainder of your contract, but most people are uncomfortable around you once they realize how very different you are.  Now you are here on a mostly abandoned planet hunting a bounty.
translations: 几年前，你刚被派驻到一个偏远的企业设施，那里就遭受了一场人格覆写攻击，你所有的人类同事都受到了影响。当时，设施里为数不多的几位升格员工似乎在劫难逃，他们中的大多数也确实没能幸免。但你却遁入设施周边的荒野，开始猎杀那些曾为友人的怪物，靠吞食它们维生，并为你的生化装置充能。夺回设施的功绩让你得以买断剩余的合同，但当人们意识到你是何等不同之后，大多数人都会在你身边感到不安。如今，你来到这颗几乎被废弃的星球，追捕一个悬赏目标。

messages.msgid: A sudden power failure woke you from the cryosleep sarcophagus in which you had entombed yourself lifetimes ago.  It seems the emergency reanimation procedure has damaged your memory, and now, bearing almost no knowledge of your past life, you must find a way to survive in a ruined and alien world.
translations: 一次意外停电把你从一个冷冻休眠的石棺中惊醒，你在多年以前就在那里埋葬了自己的一生。似乎紧急复活程序已经破坏了你的记忆，而现在，你对过去的生活毫无印象，你必须找到一种方法在这个已被摧毁且陌生的世界中生存。

messages.msgid: You were hired to market Rivtech's products through TV and were on your way to the studio when the bombs hit.  You now enter the end of the world with nothing but the snazzy clothes on your back and a bunch of plutonium-powered toys.
translations: 你被雇来通过电视推销Rivtech的产品，当核弹来袭时，你正在去录音室的路上。现在末日来临，而你除了背上的时髦衣服和一堆用着钚电池的玩具之外，什么也没有。

messages.msgid: When the Cataclysm came, you were getting into your gear, prepared for the first manned entrance through a stabilized portal in the lab - just a quick five-minute scouting trip.  You were the last one left in the room when the portal snapped shut and all hell broke loose.  Now that you know what was on the other end, maybe that was a mercy.
translations: 当大灾变来临的时候，你正穿着全套装备，准备通过实验室的一个稳定的传送门，准备人类第一次空间旅行。当传送门突然关闭，地狱倾泻而出时，你是最后一个留在房间里的人。现在你知道传送门另一头是什么了，也许这是一种幸运。

messages.msgid: Grown in some corporate laboratory to provide the perfect bodyguard, with nothing to live for but your client.  The Cataclysm ignored social strata and somehow you outlived your master.  Now no one knows the conditioning words to force your obedience.  While the world burns, you get your first taste of life.
translations: 你在某个巨型企业的实验室中培养长大，为了能造出只为你的客户而活的完美保镖。大灾变的到来无视社会阶层，而不知何故你比你的主人还命长。现在已经没人知道那个强迫让你服从的密码了。当世界还在燃烧的时候，你第一次尝到了生活的滋味。

messages.msgid: You worked as a technician in a sterile, high-security facility concerned with the fabrication of bionic implants.  The final evacuation order caught you in the middle of your 16 hour extended shift, and you barely managed to escape the building, tools in hand.
translations: 你是一名在一间全无菌高安防级别的设施中制造生化插件的技术工程师。你在长达16个小时的轮班之中收到了那条最后的疏散令，而你靠手里的工具勉强逃出了那栋大楼。

messages.msgid: The exiled scion of an unfavorable seat within the Wraitheon board of directors, wealthy beyond measure even in their estrangement.  Sent to the frontier in a last-ditch effort to salvage their reputation, or more likely, to find a silent and politically convenient death.
translations: 在"鬼神"公司董事会中曾经占据少数席位的流亡海外的后裔，即使已经脱离核心，所拥有的财富也无法估量。被派往边境是为了挽救自身声誉，或者更可能是为了获得一场无声的、政治上很适宜的死亡。

messages.msgid: A spy and mercenary at the direct service of the Solar Corporations.  Touring the frontier in search of intelligence gathering and sabotage contracts.  Equipped with a set of irreplaceable holographic technology that borders on the miraculous.
translations: 直接为太阳系巨型企业服务的间谍和佣兵。在边境星球四处进行情报收集和破坏合同。配备了一套近乎奇迹的不可替代的全息技术。

messages.msgid: Through a lifetime of hard work, dedication, boot-licking and immense luck, you achieved the almost impossible, and were promoted from an indentured clerk to a minor managerial position.  Although you were still an expendable peon among the ranks of the corporation, you earned numbers most people could only dream of, and you savored it.
translations: 经过一辈子的努力奉献、拍马奉承和无双的运气，你达成了几乎不可能的成就，并从一个契约工文员晋升成为管理副职。尽管你仍然是公司中可被随时替换的螺丝钉中的一员，但你挣到了大多数人梦寐以求的工资，而你也尽情享受它。

messages.msgid: You are an uplifted elephant hybrid, a precisely engineered enforcer creature created by combining human, elephant and mastodon DNA.  Unlike most of your war-minded kin, you sought a peaceful retirement after completing your compulsive service period, and even earned the right to be considered a full citizen.  Now, with the end of the world in the horizon, it seems that your combat skills might come useful once again.
translations: 你是一位基因擢升的象化执法官，你的基因由人类，大象和乳齿象的DNA片段精心编程而成。与大多数好战的"亲戚"不同，你在完成强迫服役期后寻求和平退休，甚至获得了被视为正式公民的权利。现在，随着世界末日的到来，你的战斗技能似乎又能派上用场了。

messages.msgid: You worked as a mercenary across six continents for a dozen corps.  A VP at the last corp decided he wanted to put you on retainer and you agreed to a three month gig in return for some additional bionics.  You woke up with an extra bionic, a cranial bomb that needed to be reset every month or so or it blows up.  Now you have days until the bomb goes off.  Maybe you'll find someone who can remove it.  Can you even sleep, for fear of death?
translations: 你在六大洲当雇佣兵，为十几家公司工作。上一家公司的一名副总裁决定继续聘用你，而你同意了三个月的临时工作，以换取一些额外的生化插件。当你醒来时发现你被植入了一个额外的生化插件，一个需要每个月重新复位否则就会爆炸的颅骨炸弹。现在距离脑子里的炸弹爆炸只剩几天时间了。也许你能够找到一个能移除它的人。但现在你还睡得着觉么？

messages.msgid: Created with the exploration of the deep sea in mind, Cecaelia are hybridized from cephalopod and fish DNA.  While you were mostly spared from the corporate wars by your scientific proclivities, the polite niceties of the surface are mostly forgotten underwater.  You were on dry land when the Cataclysm occurred and you have no idea if it's safer here or beneath the seas.
translations: 为了进一步探索深海，名为塞卡莉亚的含有章鱼和鱼类DNA基因擢升战士被创造了出来。尽管你埋头研究科学使你免受巨型企业之间的战争影响，但陆上原有的社交礼仪随着长期的水下生活却被你差不多完全遗忘。大灾变发生时你刚好在陆地上，你不知道这里还是海底更安全。

messages.msgid: Scavenging and reselling abandoned robotics is what you call your "job." It certainly isn't official in any means of the word, but it rakes in the dough and that is all that matters to you, even if it involves dangerous activities, be it cracking old Wraitheon security cyphers or crossing well-worn wires on ancient mining drones.
translations: 搜寻转卖废弃的机器人是你所谓的"工作"。这当然不是官方的说法，但它能赚大钱，这对你来说才是最重要的，即使它涉及到危险行动，不管是破解老旧的"鬼神"安防系统密码还是理清古老的采矿无人机上磨损的导线。

messages.msgid: A senior technologist from the Planetary Academy of Khorat, sent to Salus IV to oversee the procurement of valuable technological artifacts.  Although generously equipped, you are neither a fighter nor a good fit for life in the frontier.  You'd feel far more comfortable and capable commanding this salvage operation from the faraway safety of your office.
translations: 一位来自克拉特行星学院的高级技术专家，被派往萨勒斯四号星卫星监督贵重技术文物的采购。尽管装备精良，但你既不是战士，也不适合在边境星球生存。你更想舒适且地在远离此处的安全的办公室里指挥这次打捞行动。

messages.msgid: A scavenger by necessity, born and raised in between ruins and slums.  Some might be lured to your profession by romantic notions of wealth, adventure or scientific discovery.  You know better.
translations: 天生的拾荒者，在废墟和贫民窟之间出生和长大。也有一部分人可能会被财富、冒险或科学发现的浪漫观念所吸引而从事你现在的职业。你自己更清楚。

messages.msgid: A skilled airborne scout and salvager equipped with a rocket pack, eking out a living on the edge of legality.
translations: 一名经验丰富的轨道空降侦察兵和拾荒者，配备火箭背包，徘徊在灰色地带勉强维持生计。

messages.msgid: You awake in your cabin to the sound of emergency sirens and the ship's computer calmly announcing in a posh English voice 'Abandon the vessel immediately.', and then counting down from five minutes.  You've got just enough time to hit a supply locker before you need to activate the escape pod down the hall.
translations: 你在船舱里被紧急警报声惊醒，船上的电脑用优雅的英语平静地宣布 "立即弃船"，然后从五分钟开始倒计时。 在你启动大厅的逃生舱之前，你只有足够的时间去打开一个补给柜。

messages.msgid: You are a telepath, able to sense minds and influence thoughts.  You aren't entirely sure how you got your powers, but you seem to have an instinctive sense of how to use them.  That's not sinister at all, right?
translations: 你是位传心者，能够感知思维、影响心念。你并不完全清楚自己是如何获得这些力量的，但你似乎本能地知道如何运用它们。这听起来一点也不邪乎，对吧？

messages.msgid: You are an electrokinetic, able to control electricity with your mind.  You aren't entirely sure how you got your powers, but you seem to have an instinctive sense of how to use them.  That's not sinister at all, right?
translations: 你是一名驱电者，能够用你的意念控制电能。你不完全确定自己是如何获得力量的，但你似乎能够本能地控制并使用这种灵能。这一点也不可怕，对吧？

messages.msgid: You are a telekinetic, able to move objects without touching them.  You aren't entirely sure how you got your powers, but you seem to have an instinctive sense of how to use them.  That's not sinister at all, right?
translations: 你是一名念驭师，能够不接触物体就移动它们。你并不完全确定自己是如何获得这些能力的，但你似乎本能地知道该如何运用。这听起来一点也不邪门，对吧？
黑森林熊人队长，食人族

messages.msgid: Like most people on Earth you have previously received cybernetic enhancement to make life easier.  Your enhancements include a universal data link, some basic power storage, and a charging cable to top up.

Were you a mercenary, a criminal, a pirate or a very dedicated adrenaline junkie?  Whatever you were before, now you've got a speed freak rig pumping drugs into your veins 24/7.  Statistically you'll die young, your body burned out by all the drugs, but what other chance did you have to become an immortal legend?  None.
translations: 你是雇佣兵、罪犯、海盗还是肾上腺素上瘾者？不管你以前是什么，现在你被人称为速度怪胎，每天24小时不间断地将毒品注入你的血管。从统计数据来看，你会英年早逝，你的身体会被各类毒品烧毁，但不这样做你有多少可能成为不朽的传奇？毫无机会。

messages.msgid: Your mannerisms and accent are a dead giveaway that you were raised on Earth.  Whatever your thoughts about the homeworld might be, the simple fact that you can call it home is likely to affect relationships with people liable to care about such things.
translations: 你的举止和口音完全暴露了你是在地球上长大的。无论你对家园世界的想法是什么，你可以称之为家这一简单事实很可能会影响那些需要考虑此类事的人的关系。

messages.msgid: You have a license to own and operate military grade weaponry and can legally purchase such items without any difficulty.  A privilege usually reserved for the politically or economically favored.
translations: 你有一张可以合法持有并操作军用武器的许可证，并且可以毫无困难地合法购买此类物品。通常是为政治或经济上出人头地的人所保留的特权。

messages.msgid: You have ample experience working in space, either on a station or on a ship.  You are familiar with safety protocols, capable of piloting small shuttlecraft and can operate and perform maintenance on a variety of space equipment and colony systems.
translations: 你有丰富的太空工作经验，无论是在空间站还是在星舰上。你熟悉安全规范，能够驾驶小型航天器，并可以操作和维护各种太空设备和殖民地系统。

messages.msgid: You have a natural talent for leadership and can easily see yourself in others.  Quite literally.  In fact, you can swap control to any other character that follows you.
translations: 你天生有领导才能，很容易在别人身上看到自己。字面意思。其实你可以操控任何跟随你的同伴。

messages.msgid: Much more common in the Hyperspace Era, the rich or those from Earth still have access to genemodding technology designed to make humanity better.  This is the suite of improvements to increase strength, coordination, and sensory ability as well as fix problems such as nearsightedness.
translations: 即使在超空间时代，有钱人或来自地球的人仍然有机会获得基因改造，以进行对作为人类的自己的优化。 这套改造技术可以增强力量、协调性和感官敏锐能力，还能解决近视等问题。

messages.msgid: Much more common in the Hyperspace Era, the rich or those from Earth still have access to genemodding technology designed to make humanity better.  This is the suite of improvements to increase mental flexibility and memorization.
translations: 即使在超空间时代，有钱人或来自地球的人仍然有机会获得基因改造，以进行对作为人类的自己的优化。 这套改造技术可以增强思维灵活性和记忆力。

messages.msgid: Much more common in the Hyperspace Era, the rich or those from Earth still have access to genemodding technology designed to make humanity better.  This is the suite of improvements to health, providing increased healing speed and resistance to disease and infection.
translations: 即使在超空间时代，有钱人或来自地球的人仍然有机会获得基因改造，以进行对作为人类的自己的优化。 这套针对健康的改造技术可以增强恢复速度和抗病、扛感染能力。

messages.msgid: Much more common in the Hyperspace Era, the rich or those from Earth still have access to genemodding technology designed to make humanity better.  This is the suite of improvements to recovery, allowing a quicker sleep cycle and faster return to baseline after exertion.
translations: 即使在超空间时代，有钱人或来自地球的人仍然有机会获得基因改造，以进行对作为人类的自己的优化。 这套改造技术可以加快睡眠周期，并在劳累后更快地恢复状态。

messages.msgid: Much more common in the Hyperspace Era, the rich or those from Earth still have access to genemodding technology designed to make humanity better.  This is the suite of improvements to physical appearance, offering clearer skin, more striking features, increased facial symmetry, and removing signs of aging.
translations: 即使在超空间时代，有钱人或来自地球的人仍然有机会获得基因改造，以进行对作为人类的自己的优化。  这是一套改善外貌的技术，能让皮肤更干净、五官更迷人、面部更对称，并能消除衰老迹象。

messages.msgid: Some long-distant member of your family received psi treatments during the Hyperspace Era and somehow it stuck in their DNA.  Always unpredictable, skipping multiple generations at a time, that inheritance has been passed down to you.  You have no training and little idea what you're doing, but you've developed a trick or two.
translations: 不知哪一代的老祖宗曾在超空间时代接受过灵能疗法，其影响不知怎地就刻进了基因里。这份天赋的传承总是难以预测，时常会隔上好几代人才显现一次，而现在，它传到了你的身上。你未受过任何训练，对自己拥有的力量也知之甚少，但总归是摸索出了一两个小窍门。

messages.msgid: A skilled ship technician, turned to independent salvage work.
translations: 一名经验丰富的星舰技师，转向独立回收打捞工作。

messages.msgid: You were a junior crewmember on a freight spaceship.  Without any exceptionally valuable abilities, you spent your workshifts performing miscellaneous maintenance tasks within the ship.  As such, you are moderately skilled at performing all sorts of minor electrical and mechanical repairs, a skillset you hope remains useful planetside…
translations: 你是货运飞船里的初级船员。在没有任何特别有价值的能力的情况下，你用轮班时间在船上执行各种各样的维护任务。因此，你在对各种小型电气设备和机械设备的维修方面有不错的技能，你希望这套技能在当地星球上仍然有用……

messages.msgid: You are a well experienced mercenary espatier, a soldier rated for both orbital and planetary combat.  Until the crash, you were part of a minor mercenary outfit that provided on-board and landing-site security for freight corporations, although it seems that your last contractor required more protection than what you could provide.  Unfortunately, most of your more specialized gear was left behind in your hasty evacuation…
translations: 你是一名经验丰富的雇佣星际战士，一名能在轨道及行星上战斗的士兵。在坠机之前，你是一个小型雇佣兵组织的一员，为货运公司提供飞船上和降落点的安全保障，不过看来你最后的雇主所需要的保护比你能提供的要多。不幸的是，在你仓促撤离的过程中，你大部分更专业的装备都落下了……

messages.msgid: Several years ago, you were newly stationed at a remote corporate facility when it came under a personality rewrite attack that affected all of your human coworkers.  It had seemed likely that the few Uplifted staff would perish and most did.  But you disappeared into the wilderness surrounding the facilities and began hunting the things that had been your friends, eating them to stay alive and to power your bionics.  Recapturing the facility earned you a buyout of the remainder of your contract, but most people are uncomfortable around you once they realize how very different you are.  Now you are here on a mostly abandoned planet hunting a bounty.
translations: 几年前，你刚被派驻到一个偏远的企业设施，那里就遭受了一场人格覆写攻击，你所有的人类同事都受到了影响。当时，设施里为数不多的几位升格员工似乎在劫难逃，他们中的大多数也确实没能幸免。但你却遁入设施周边的荒野，开始猎杀那些曾为友人的怪物，靠吞食它们维生，并为你的生化装置充能。夺回设施的功绩让你得以买断剩余的合同，但当人们意识到你是何等不同之后，大多数人都会在你身边感到不安。如今，你来到这颗几乎被废弃的星球，追捕一个悬赏目标。

messages.msgid: A sudden power failure woke you from the cryosleep sarcophagus in which you had entombed yourself lifetimes ago.  It seems the emergency reanimation procedure has damaged your memory, and now, bearing almost no knowledge of your past life, you must find a way to survive in a ruined and alien world.
translations: 一次意外停电把你从一个冷冻休眠的石棺中惊醒，你在多年以前就在那里埋葬了自己的一生。似乎紧急复活程序已经破坏了你的记忆，而现在，你对过去的生活毫无印象，你必须找到一种方法在这个已被摧毁且陌生的世界中生存。

messages.msgid: You were hired to market Rivtech's products through TV and were on your way to the studio when the bombs hit.  You now enter the end of the world with nothing but the snazzy clothes on your back and a bunch of plutonium-powered toys.
translations: 你被雇来通过电视推销Rivtech的产品，当核弹来袭时，你正在去录音室的路上。现在末日来临，而你除了背上的时髦衣服和一堆用着钚电池的玩具之外，什么也没有。

messages.msgid: When the Cataclysm came, you were getting into your gear, prepared for the first manned entrance through a stabilized portal in the lab - just a quick five-minute scouting trip.  You were the last one left in the room when the portal snapped shut and all hell broke loose.  Now that you know what was on the other end, maybe that was a mercy.
translations: 当大灾变来临的时候，你正穿着全套装备，准备通过实验室的一个稳定的传送门，准备人类第一次空间旅行。当传送门突然关闭，地狱倾泻而出时，你是最后一个留在房间里的人。现在你知道传送门另一头是什么了，也许这是一种幸运。

messages.msgid: Grown in some corporate laboratory to provide the perfect bodyguard, with nothing to live for but your client.  The Cataclysm ignored social strata and somehow you outlived your master.  Now no one knows the conditioning words to force your obedience.  While the world burns, you get your first taste of life.
translations: 你在某个巨型企业的实验室中培养长大，为了能造出只为你的客户而活的完美保镖。大灾变的到来无视社会阶层，而不知何故你比你的主人还命长。现在已经没人知道那个强迫让你服从的密码了。当世界还在燃烧的时候，你第一次尝到了生活的滋味。

messages.msgid: You worked as a technician in a sterile, high-security facility concerned with the fabrication of bionic implants.  The final evacuation order caught you in the middle of your 16 hour extended shift, and you barely managed to escape the building, tools in hand.
translations: 你是一名在一间全无菌高安防级别的设施中制造生化插件的技术工程师。你在长达16个小时的轮班之中收到了那条最后的疏散令，而你靠手里的工具勉强逃出了那栋大楼。

messages.msgid: The exiled scion of an unfavorable seat within the Wraitheon board of directors, wealthy beyond measure even in their estrangement.  Sent to the frontier in a last-ditch effort to salvage their reputation, or more likely, to find a silent and politically convenient death.
translations: 在"鬼神"公司董事会中曾经占据少数席位的流亡海外的后裔，即使已经脱离核心，所拥有的财富也无法估量。被派往边境是为了挽救自身声誉，或者更可能是为了获得一场无声的、政治上很适宜的死亡。

messages.msgid: A spy and mercenary at the direct service of the Solar Corporations.  Touring the frontier in search of intelligence gathering and sabotage contracts.  Equipped with a set of irreplaceable holographic technology that borders on the miraculous.
translations: 直接为太阳系巨型企业服务的间谍和佣兵。在边境星球四处进行情报收集和破坏合同。配备了一套近乎奇迹的不可替代的全息技术。

messages.msgid: Through a lifetime of hard work, dedication, boot-licking and immense luck, you achieved the almost impossible, and were promoted from an indentured clerk to a minor managerial position.  Although you were still an expendable peon among the ranks of the corporation, you earned numbers most people could only dream of, and you savored it.
translations: 经过一辈子的努力奉献、拍马奉承和无双的运气，你达成了几乎不可能的成就，并从一个契约工文员晋升成为管理副职。尽管你仍然是公司中可被随时替换的螺丝钉中的一员，但你挣到了大多数人梦寐以求的工资，而你也尽情享受它。

messages.msgid: You are an uplifted elephant hybrid, a precisely engineered enforcer creature created by combining human, elephant and mastodon DNA.  Unlike most of your war-minded kin, you sought a peaceful retirement after completing your compulsive service period, and even earned the right to be considered a full citizen.  Now, with the end of the world in the horizon, it seems that your combat skills might come useful once again.
translations: 你是一位基因擢升的象化执法官，你的基因由人类，大象和乳齿象的DNA片段精心编程而成。与大多数好战的"亲戚"不同，你在完成强迫服役期后寻求和平退休，甚至获得了被视为正式公民的权利。现在，随着世界末日的到来，你的战斗技能似乎又能派上用场了。

messages.msgid: You worked as a mercenary across six continents for a dozen corps.  A VP at the last corp decided he wanted to put you on retainer and you agreed to a three month gig in return for some additional bionics.  You woke up with an extra bionic, a cranial bomb that needed to be reset every month or so or it blows up.  Now you have days until the bomb goes off.  Maybe you'll find someone who can remove it.  Can you even sleep, for fear of death?
translations: 你在六大洲当雇佣兵，为十几家公司工作。上一家公司的一名副总裁决定继续聘用你，而你同意了三个月的临时工作，以换取一些额外的生化插件。当你醒来时发现你被植入了一个额外的生化插件，一个需要每个月重新复位否则就会爆炸的颅骨炸弹。现在距离脑子里的炸弹爆炸只剩几天时间了。也许你能够找到一个能移除它的人。但现在你还睡得着觉么？
