messages.msgid: You are a telepath, able to sense minds and influence thoughts.  You aren't entirely sure how you got your powers, but you seem to have an instinctive sense of how to use them.  That's not sinister at all, right?
translations: 你是位传心者，能够感知思维、影响心念。你并不完全清楚自己是如何获得这些力量的，但你似乎本能地知道如何运用它们。这听起来一点也不邪乎，对吧？

messages.msgid: You are an electrokinetic, able to control electricity with your mind.  You aren't entirely sure how you got your powers, but you seem to have an instinctive sense of how to use them.  That's not sinister at all, right?
translations: 你是一名驱电者，能够用你的意念控制电能。你不完全确定自己是如何获得力量的，但你似乎能够本能地控制并使用这种灵能。这一点也不可怕，对吧？

messages.msgid: You are a telekinetic, able to move objects without touching them.  You aren't entirely sure how you got your powers, but you seem to have an instinctive sense of how to use them.  That's not sinister at all, right?
translations: 你是一名念动者，能够不接触物体就移动它们。你并不完全确定自己是如何获得这些能力的，但你似乎本能地知道该如何运用。这听起来一点也不邪门，对吧？

messages.msgid: One Last Dance on the Ice
One Last Dance on the Ice
During the riots and chaos, you hid in a robot dispatch center hoping the robots would protect you, but they may prove more dangerous than the zombies.
translations: 在骚乱和混乱中，你躲在机器人调度中心希望机器人能保护你，但它们可能比丧尸更危险。

messages.msgid: The Cryosleeper slow approach allows the display of Salus IV through all its forms: a fiery marble against interstellar darkness, a silver-white mirror, and a final world of glaciers split by the thin ruins of an equatorial metroplex.  Before long, Port Augustmoon's ancient hull comes to obstruct most the viewport, and the ship's computer announces that it is time to disembark.
translations: 冷冻休眠舱缓缓抵近Salus IV卫星，使它能够展示出各种形态：一颗对抗横跨星际的黑暗的白炽弹珠，一面银白色的镜子，又或是一个被赤道大都市的细细废墟所分割的冰川终极世界。很快，秋月港古老的空间站体挡住了大部分视线，船舱内的电脑宣告是时候该出舱了。

messages.msgid: What was to be a routine cargo transfer ended in tragedy when, in a brief moment of chaos, your space ship was intercepted and destroyed by a StO missile.  As soon as the MAW alarm flared to life, you scrambled to the nearest escape pod and barely managed to reach the uncertain safety of the planet below.
translations: 在短暂的混乱中，你的飞船被一枚地对天导弹拦截并摧毁，这本是一次例行的货物转运任务，结果却以悲剧告终。导弹逼近警报一响起，你就爬进了最近的逃生舱，勉强到达了下方星球的不确定的安全地带。

messages.msgid: You've chased your quarry from the tragedies they left behind in the core of civilized space; all the way out here to the fringes of inhabited space.  You caught up with their ship here in the Salus system, and heavily damaged it, but the combat didn't leave your ship unscathed.  Opportunistic scavengers or pirates you don't know which ambushed you as you were harrying your mark's ship and forcing it to ground.  You know they'll have crash landed somewhere on this planet but your ship, Truth and Reconciliation will never fly again.  You won't even walk away from this icy wreck if you can't destroy the squad of drones and scavenger bots that have dropped in to finish you off.

You've already been modified mutagenically but now you were all ready for a bionic implant or three - the bill footed by the corp, of course - when everything went pear-shaped and all you could hear from the other rooms was screaming.  For a few hours, at least.  Now all you can hear is shuffling, crackling, the occasional gurgling, burbling moan, and heavy, wet thumps.  Hopefully your surgery was registered as an elective because you've elected to get the heck out of here!
translations: 你已经接受了诱变改造，正准备再安装一两件生化插件——费用当然由公司全包——但情况却急转直下，你唯一能听到的，就是从其他房间传来的阵阵尖叫，这尖叫至少持续了几个小时。现在，你耳边只剩下曳步声、爆裂声，偶尔夹杂着喉咙里的咯咯声、含混不清的呻吟，以及沉重湿腻的撞击声。但愿你的手术在登记时属于“自选项目”，因为你现在已经“选择”了——赶紧逃离这个鬼地方！

messages.msgid: You must have hit your head when the first explosion happened.  You sit up and realize everyone is gone, that the air smells like smoke, and that the ship's computer is calmly announcing in a posh English voice 'Abandon the vessel immediately.', and then counting down from seven minutes.  Time to grab what you can and find an escape pod.
translations: 第一次爆炸发生时，你一定是撞到了头。 你坐起身来，发现所有人都不见了，空气中弥漫着烟味，飞船的电脑正用优雅的英语平静地宣布 "立即弃船"，然后从七分钟开始倒计时。 是时候抓紧时间找到逃生舱了。

messages.msgid:
There are stories that before the Discontinuity, scientists had developed treatments to unlock the powers of the human mind.  To read thoughts, move objects at a distance, control computers by the power of will alone, and even stranger things.  Just one more lost secret of the Golden Age.

Or so you thought, but recently you had heard some tantalizing rumors about espers, centered on a backwater planet on the edge of known civilization.  You remember buying passage to the Salus system, arriving at Port Augustmoon and buying supplies, and descending to the surface, and after that…things get hazy.  You're not entirely sure where you are, and you've clearly been through it, but somehow you've rediscovered that lost secret.  Now you just need to make it back alive.
translations:
有故事说，在 “不连续 ”之前，科学家们已经开发出了释放人类心灵力量的治疗方法。 读取思想 远距离移动物体 仅凭意志力就能控制电脑 甚至还有更奇怪的东西  这只是黄金时代又一个失落的秘密

你是这么想的 但最近你听到了一些关于超异能者的诱人传言 这些超异能者都集中在已知文明边缘的一个偏僻星球上  你记得自己买了前往萨卢斯星系的通行证，到达奥古斯蒙港后购买了补给品，然后下到地面，之后......事情就变得模糊不清了。 你并不完全确定自己身在何处，而且你显然已经经历过这一切，但不知何故，你重新发现了那个失落的秘密。 现在，你只需要活着回去。
